		box(f, "PropaneCage" .. i, Vector3.new(6.6, 3.4, 0.2), Vector3.new(-146.0, FC_TOP + 1.7, zp + 2.0), C.GALV, M.DiamondPlate, 90, "LSC_EastPropane" .. i, 2, { transparency = 0.3 })
	end
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local zp = 62.0 + (i - 1) * 8.0
		local grp = "LSC_WallACU" .. tostring(i)
		box(f, "ACUFrame" .. i, Vector3.new(2.4, 4.4, 5.0), Vector3.new(EAST_XC + 1.6, FC_TOP + 2.4, zp), C.GALV, M.Metal, 150, grp .. "_Frame", 1)
		cyl(f, "ACUFan" .. i, Vector3.new(0.4, 3.6, 3.6), CFrame.new(EAST_XC + 2.9, FC_TOP + 2.4, zp), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 90, grp .. "_Fan", 2)
		box(f, "ACUPad" .. i, Vector3.new(3.0, 0.4, 5.4), Vector3.new(EAST_XC + 1.6, FC_TOP + 0.2, zp), C.CONCRETE_DARK, M.Concrete, 120, grp .. "_Pad", 1)
	end
	-- =========================================================================
	-- Giá kệ sắt HỞ 3 tầng: 4 chân đứng + dầm ngang, thùng gỗ NẰM TRÊN dầm
	-- (bản cũ là 1 khối đặc 2×8×9 bị thùng gỗ xuyên qua -> đã sửa 100% chồng lấn)
	-- =========================================================================
	local rackZ0, rackZ1 = 81.6, 90.4
	local rackXA, rackXB = -142.55, -140.45
	local rackZc = (rackZ0 + rackZ1) * 0.5
	local upIdx = 1
	for _, zz in ipairs({ rackZ0, rackZ1 }) do
		for _, xx in ipairs({ rackXA, rackXB }) do
			box(f, "EastRackUpright" .. upIdx, Vector3.new(0.26, 8.40, 0.26), Vector3.new(xx, FC_TOP + 4.20, zz), C.ORANGE_TOOL, M.Metal, 110, "LSC_EastRackFrame", 1)
			upIdx += 1
		end
	end
	local shelfY = { FC_TOP + 1.45, FC_TOP + 3.95, FC_TOP + 6.45 }
	for i, sy in ipairs(shelfY) do
		for k, xx in ipairs({ rackXA + 0.14, rackXB - 0.14 }) do
			box(f, "EastRackRail" .. i .. "_" .. k, Vector3.new(0.14, 0.18, rackZ1 - rackZ0 + 0.42), Vector3.new(xx, sy, rackZc), C.ORANGE_TOOL, M.Metal, 70, "LSC_EastRackShelf" .. i, 2)
		end
		for k, zz in ipairs({ rackZ0, rackZ1 }) do
			box(f, "EastRackCross" .. i .. "_" .. k, Vector3.new(rackXB - rackXA + 0.30, 0.18, 0.14), Vector3.new((rackXA + rackXB) * 0.5, sy, zz), C.ORANGE_TOOL, M.Metal, 70, "LSC_EastRackShelf" .. i, 2)
		end
		box(f, "EastRackBox" .. i, Vector3.new(1.50, 1.50, 3.00), Vector3.new((rackXA + rackXB) * 0.5, sy + 0.84, rackZc), C.WOOD, M.WoodPlanks, 60, "LSC_EastRackBox" .. i, 3)
	end
	-- Hàng rào sân hông Đông
	local cursor = -6.0
	local idx = 1
	while cursor < 118.0 do
		local seg = math.min(118.0, cursor + 9.0)
		box(f, "EastYardFenceMesh" .. idx, Vector3.new(0.12, 4.0, seg - cursor - 0.3), Vector3.new(-139.8, FC_TOP + 2.0, (cursor + seg) * 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(150, 156, 162), M.DiamondPlate, 70, "LSC_EastYardFence" .. idx, 1, { transparency = 0.35 })
		box(f, "EastYardFencePost" .. idx, Vector3.new(0.3, 4.4, 0.3), Vector3.new(-139.8, FC_TOP + 2.2, seg), C.GALV, M.Metal, 110, "LSC_EastYardFencePost" .. idx, 1)
		cursor = seg
		idx += 1
	end
end

-- =============================================================================
-- 19. LẮP RÁP TOÀN BỘ CÔNG TRÌNH
-- =============================================================================
function Module.build(modulesContainer: Instance): Instance
	local root = folder("Plot_C1_LSCustoms", modulesContainer)
	root:SetAttribute("WorldModuleId", "Plot_C1_LSCustoms")
	root:SetAttribute("PlotId", "Plot_C1")
	root:SetAttribute("District", "DEL PERRO")
	root:SetAttribute("GroundY", GROUND_Y)
	root:SetAttribute("FloorTopY", FLOOR_TOP)
	root:SetAttribute("MainGatePosition", Vector3.new(-238.0, FC_TOP, 118.0))
	root:SetAttribute("VehicleGateZ", 119.5)
	root:SetAttribute("PedestrianDoorPosition", Vector3.new(-206.5, FLOOR_TOP, BZ1))
	root:SetAttribute("Agent", "arena/e461e643-robloxstudio-connecting")

	buildFloor(root)
	buildShell(root)
	buildBayDoors(root)
	buildStorefront(root)
	buildSignage(root)
	buildRoof(root)
	buildLifts(root)
	buildToolWall(root)
	buildBackStorage(root)
	buildCustomerLounge(root)
	buildCeiling(root)
	buildMezzanine(root)
	buildForecourt(root)
	buildSideYards(root)

	return root
end

return Module

PartBuilder.source:
--!strict
--[[
	PartBuilder.luau (Modular Destructible Voxel Engine)
	Bộ công cụ dựng hình chuẩn hóa cho toàn bộ thế giới GTA V Los Santos:
	- Mọi khối tường, dải phân cách, bồn đá, lan can, cọc chắn và công trình về sau đều tạo từ
	  các khối vật lý rời có gắn Attribute:
	    + Destructible (boolean)
	    + MaxIntegrity / Integrity (number)
	    + FractureGroup (string)
	    + StructuralRow (number: tầng kết cấu từ dưới lên để tính sập dây chuyền)
]]

local PartBuilder = {}

export type PartSpec = {
	name: string?,
	parent: Instance,
	size: Vector3,
	pos: Vector3?,
	cframe: CFrame?,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	transparency: number?,
	reflectance: number?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
	castShadow: boolean?,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	destructible: boolean?,
	integrity: number?,
	fractureGroup: string?,
	structuralRow: number?,
}

export type MasonryWallSpec = {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	axis: "X" | "Z", -- Tường chạy dọc trục X (từ min -> max tại fixedCoord Z) hoặc trục Z
	fixedCoord: number,
	minCoord: number,
	maxCoord: number,
	baseY: number,
	thickness: number,
	courses: number,
	courseHeight: number,
	blockLength: number,
	mortarGap: number?,
	baseColor: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	colorJitter: number?,
	integrity: number?,
	fractureGroup: string,
	addCoping: boolean?,
	copingColor: Color3?,
}

export type StaircaseSpec = {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	origin: Vector3, -- Tâm chân bậc đầu tiên (ở cao độ thấp)
	dir: Vector3, -- Hướng bước lên: Vector3.new(0,0,-1), (0,0,1), (1,0,0), (-1,0,0)
	width: number,
	steps: number,
	totalRise: number,
	totalRun: number,
	color: Color3,
	cheekColor: Color3?,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	fractureGroup: string?,
}

local function applyDestructionTags(
	inst: BasePart,
	destructible: boolean?,
	integrity: number?,
	group: string?,
	row: number?
)
	local isDest = if destructible ~= nil then destructible else false
	inst:SetAttribute("Destructible", isDest)
	if isDest then
		local hp = integrity or 100
		inst:SetAttribute("MaxPartHealth", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("PartHealth", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("MaxIntegrity", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("Integrity", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("FractureGroup", group or "WorldProp")
		inst:SetAttribute("StructuralRow", row or 1)
	end
end

local function tintColor(base: Color3, seedA: number, seedB: number, jitter: number): Color3
	local h = ((seedA * 73856093 + seedB * 19349663) % 29) - 14
	local delta = (h / 14.0) * (jitter / 255.0)
	return Color3.new(
		math.clamp(base.R + delta, 0, 1),
		math.clamp(base.G + delta, 0, 1),
		math.clamp(base.B + delta * 0.85, 0, 1)
	)
end

function PartBuilder.part(spec: PartSpec): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = spec.name or "Part"
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if spec.shape then
		p.Shape = spec.shape
	end
	p.Size = spec.size
	if spec.cframe then
		p.CFrame = spec.cframe
	elseif spec.pos then
		p.Position = spec.pos
	end
	p.Color = spec.color
	p.Material = spec.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Transparency = spec.transparency or 0
	p.Reflectance = spec.reflectance or 0
	if spec.canCollide ~= nil then
		p.CanCollide = spec.canCollide
	end
	if spec.castShadow ~= nil then
		p.CastShadow = spec.castShadow
	end
	applyDestructionTags(p, spec.destructible, spec.integrity, spec.fractureGroup, spec.structuralRow)
	p.Parent = spec.parent
	return p
end

function PartBuilder.wedge(spec: PartSpec): WedgePart
	local w = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	w.Name = spec.name or "Wedge"
	w.Anchored = true
	w.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	w.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	w.Size = spec.size
	if spec.cframe then
		w.CFrame = spec.cframe
	elseif spec.pos then
		w.Position = spec.pos
	end
	w.Color = spec.color
	w.Material = spec.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	w.Transparency = spec.transparency or 0
	if spec.canCollide ~= nil then
		w.CanCollide = spec.canCollide
	end
	if spec.castShadow ~= nil then
		w.CastShadow = spec.castShadow
	end
	applyDestructionTags(w, spec.destructible, spec.integrity, spec.fractureGroup, spec.structuralRow)
	w.Parent = spec.parent
	return w
end

-- Dựng mảng tường đá / gạch / bê tông ghép so le từng viên vật lý độc lập (Running-Bond Destructible Masonry)
function PartBuilder.masonryWall(spec: MasonryWallSpec): Folder
	local wallFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	wallFolder.Name = spec.name
	wallFolder.Parent = spec.parent

	local gap = spec.mortarGap or 0.08
	local mat = spec.material or Enum.Material.Concrete
	local jitter = spec.colorJitter or 7
	local hp = spec.integrity or 130
	local totalLen = spec.maxCoord - spec.minCoord
	if totalLen <= 0.2 then
		return wallFolder
	end

	for row = 1, spec.courses do
		local cy = spec.baseY + (row - 0.5) * spec.courseHeight
		local actualH = math.max(0.15, spec.courseHeight - gap * 0.6)
		local stagger = if (row % 2 == 0) then (spec.blockLength * 0.5) else 0

		local cursor = spec.minCoord
		local colIdx = 1
		while cursor < spec.maxCoord - 0.05 do
			local targetLen = if colIdx == 1 and stagger > 0 then stagger else spec.blockLength
			local segEnd = math.min(spec.maxCoord, cursor + targetLen)
			local segLen = segEnd - cursor
			if segLen < 0.8 and cursor > spec.minCoord then
				break
			end
			local drawLen = math.max(0.4, segLen - gap)
			local mid = (cursor + segEnd) * 0.5

			local pos = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(mid, cy, spec.fixedCoord)
				else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, cy, mid)
			local sz = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(drawLen, actualH, spec.thickness)
				else Vector3.new(spec.thickness, actualH, drawLen)

			PartBuilder.part({
				name = string.format("Block_R%d_C%d", row, colIdx),
				parent = wallFolder,
				pos = pos,
				size = sz,
				color = tintColor(spec.baseColor, row + math.floor(spec.fixedCoord), colIdx, jitter),
				material = mat,
				destructible = true,
				integrity = hp,
				fractureGroup = spec.fractureGroup,
				structuralRow = row,
			})

			cursor = segEnd
			colIdx += 1
		end
	end

	if spec.addCoping then
		local topY = spec.baseY + spec.courses * spec.courseHeight + 0.16
		local capW = spec.thickness + 0.36
		local capStep = spec.blockLength * 1.25
		local cur = spec.minCoord
		local idx = 1
		while cur < spec.maxCoord - 0.05 do
			local nxt = math.min(spec.maxCoord, cur + capStep)
			local ln = math.max(0.5, (nxt - cur) - gap)
			local mid = (cur + nxt) * 0.5
			local pos = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(mid, topY, spec.fixedCoord)
				else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, topY, mid)
			local sz = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(ln, 0.32, capW)
				else Vector3.new(capW, 0.32, ln)

			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "CopingStone_" .. tostring(idx),
				parent = wallFolder,
				pos = pos,
				size = sz,
				color = spec.copingColor or Color3.fromRGB(204, 200, 192),
				material = Enum.Material.Sandstone,
				destructible = true,
				integrity = math.floor(hp * 0.85),
				fractureGroup = spec.fractureGroup,
				structuralRow = spec.courses + 1,
			})
			cur = nxt
			idx += 1
		end
	end

	return wallFolder
end

-- Dựng dải phân cách bê tông K-Rail (California Jersey Barrier) từng đốt rời có thể húc văng
function PartBuilder.jerseyBarrierRun(spec: {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixedCoord: number,
	minCoord: number,
	maxCoord: number,
	baseY: number,
	segmentLength: number?,
	fractureGroup: string,
}): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = spec.name
	folder.Parent = spec.parent

	local segLen = spec.segmentLength or 13.5
	local gap = 0.45
	local cur = spec.minCoord
	local idx = 1

	while cur + 2.0 <= spec.maxCoord do
		local nxt = math.min(spec.maxCoord, cur + segLen)
		local drawL = (nxt - cur) - gap
		local mid = (cur + nxt) * 0.5
		local unitGroup = string.format("%s_Seg%d", spec.fractureGroup, idx)

		local basePos = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(mid, spec.baseY + 0.45, spec.fixedCoord)
			else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, spec.baseY + 0.45, mid)
		local baseSz = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(drawL, 0.9, 2.2)
			else Vector3.new(2.2, 0.9, drawL)

		local topPos = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(mid, spec.baseY + 1.45, spec.fixedCoord)
			else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, spec.baseY + 1.45, mid)
		local topSz = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(drawL, 1.15, 1.1)
			else Vector3.new(1.1, 1.15, drawL)

		local col = tintColor(Color3.fromRGB(168, 172, 178), idx, 7, 5)
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "KRailBase_" .. tostring(idx),
			parent = folder,
			pos = basePos,
			size = baseSz,
			color = col,
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 240,
			fractureGroup = unitGroup,
			structuralRow = 1,
		})
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "KRailSpine_" .. tostring(idx),
			parent = folder,
			pos = topPos,
			size = topSz,
			color = col,
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 210,
			fractureGroup = unitGroup,
			structuralRow = 2,
		})

		-- Miếng phản quang vàng trên đỉnh mỗi đốt dải phân cách cao tốc
		local reflPos = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(mid, spec.baseY + 2.08, spec.fixedCoord)
			else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, spec.baseY + 2.08, mid)
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "KRailReflector_" .. tostring(idx),
			parent = folder,
			pos = reflPos,
			size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.14, 0.45),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 192, 42),
			material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			canCollide = false,
			castShadow = false,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 40,
			fractureGroup = unitGroup,
			structuralRow = 3,
		})

		cur = nxt
		idx += 1
	end

	return folder
end

-- Dựng hàng cọc thép chống đâm xe trên vỉa hè / quảng trường (húc bay từng cọc như GTA V!)
function PartBuilder.bollardLine(spec: {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	startPos: Vector3,
	endPos: Vector3,
	count: number,
	fractureGroup: string,
}): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = spec.name
	folder.Parent = spec.parent

	for i = 0, math.max(0, spec.count - 1) do
		local alpha = if spec.count <= 1 then 0.5 else (i / (spec.count - 1))
		local p = spec.startPos + (spec.endPos - spec.startPos) * alpha
		local grp = string.format("%s_Bollard%d", spec.fractureGroup, i + 1)

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "BollardPost_" .. tostring(i + 1),
			parent = folder,
			pos = Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + 1.35, p.Z),
			size = Vector3.new(0.75, 2.7, 0.75),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 47, 56),
			material = Enum.Material.Metal,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 75,
			fractureGroup = grp,
			structuralRow = 1,
		})
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "BollardRing_" .. tostring(i + 1),
			parent = folder,
			pos = Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + 2.35, p.Z),
			size = Vector3.new(0.82, 0.22, 0.82),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 46),
			material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			canCollide = false,
			castShadow = false,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 50,
			fractureGroup = grp,
			structuralRow = 2,
		})
	end

	return folder
end

-- Dựng bậc tam cấp / cầu thang đi bộ thật (mỗi bậc là 1 khối độc lập)
function PartBuilder.staircase(spec: StaircaseSpec): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = spec.name
	folder.Parent = spec.parent

	local riser = spec.totalRise / spec.steps
	local tread = spec.totalRun / spec.steps
	local mat = spec.material or Enum.Material.Sandstone
	local isZ = math.abs(spec.dir.Z) > 0.5

	for s = 1, spec.steps do
		local stepH = s * riser
		local offset = (s - 0.5) * tread
		local pos = Vector3.new(
			spec.origin.X + spec.dir.X * offset,
			spec.origin.Y + stepH * 0.5,
			spec.origin.Z + spec.dir.Z * offset
		)
		local sz = if isZ
			then Vector3.new(spec.width, stepH, tread + 0.15)
			else Vector3.new(tread + 0.15, stepH, spec.width)

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "Step_" .. tostring(s),
			parent = folder,
			pos = pos,
			size = sz,
			color = tintColor(spec.color, s, 3, 4),
			material = mat,
			destructible = false,
		})
	end

	-- 2 thành lan can đá thấp hai bên cầu thang (Destructible = true)
	local midOffset = spec.totalRun * 0.5
	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local cheekPos = if isZ
			then Vector3.new(spec.origin.X + side * (spec.width * 0.5 + 0.65), spec.origin.Y + spec.totalRise * 0.55, spec.origin.Z + spec.dir.Z * midOffset)
			else Vector3.new(spec.origin.X + spec.dir.X * midOffset, spec.origin.Y + spec.totalRise * 0.55, spec.origin.Z + side * (spec.width * 0.5 + 0.65))
		local cheekSz = if isZ
			then Vector3.new(1.3, spec.totalRise + 1.1, spec.totalRun + 0.8)
			else Vector3.new(spec.totalRun + 0.8, spec.totalRise + 1.1, 1.3)

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "StairCheekWall_" .. tostring(side),
			parent = folder,
			pos = cheekPos,
			size = cheekSz,
			color = spec.cheekColor or Color3.fromRGB(168, 164, 156),
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 160,
			fractureGroup = (spec.fractureGroup or spec.name) .. "_Cheek" .. tostring(side),
			structuralRow = 1,
		})
	end

	return folder
end

-- Bia mốc quy hoạch nhỏ gọn ở lối vào ô đất (thay cho tấm bảng đen to thô giữa đất)
function PartBuilder.surveyMonument(
	parent: Instance,
	pos: Vector3,
	codeText: string,
	subText: string,
	accentColor: Color3?
): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "SurveyMonument_" .. codeText
	f.Parent = parent

	PartBuilder.part({
		name = "MonumentBase",
		parent = f,
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 0.45, pos.Z),
		size = Vector3.new(11.5, 0.9, 2.2),
		color = Color3.fromRGB(156, 160, 168),
		material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
		destructible = true,
		integrity = 140,
		fractureGroup = "Monument_" .. codeText,
		structuralRow = 1,
	})

	local signBoard = PartBuilder.part({
		name = "MonumentBoard",
		parent = f,
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 2.1, pos.Z),
		size = Vector3.new(10.6, 2.5, 0.9),
		color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 30, 40),
		material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		destructible = true,
		integrity = 100,
		fractureGroup = "Monument_" .. codeText,
		structuralRow = 2,
	})

	for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back }) do
		local sgui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		sgui.Face = face
		sgui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
		sgui.PixelsPerStud = 36
		sgui.LightInfluence = 0.15
		sgui.Parent = signBoard

		local topStripe = Instance.new("Frame")
		topStripe.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0)
		topStripe.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor or Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 46)
		topStripe.BorderSizePixel = 0
		topStripe.Parent = sgui

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.44)
		title.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.14)
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		title.TextScaled = true
		title.TextColor3 = accentColor or Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 46)
		title.Text = codeText
		title.Parent = sgui

		local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sub.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.3)
		sub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.6)
		sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		sub.TextScaled = true
		sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 228, 238)
		sub.Text = subText
		sub.Parent = sgui
	end

	return f
end

return PartBuilder

WorldGrid.source:
--!strict
--[[
	WorldGrid.luau
	Bảng Tọa Độ Chuẩn Los Santos (Symmetric Master Grid — 0.000-stud gap)
	Mọi module ở các Giai đoạn 1 -> 7 đều đọc chung từ đây để ghép vừa khít 100%.
]]

export type RoadDef = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z", -- "X": chạy Đông-Tây, "Z": chạy Bắc-Nam
	coord: number,
	width: number,
	min: number,
	max: number,
	lanes: number,
}

export type PlotDef = {
	id: string,
	district: string,
	subtitle: string,
	center: Vector3,
	size: Vector3,
	reservedForPhase: number,
}

local WorldGrid = {}

WorldGrid.MAP_HALF_SIZE = 360
WorldGrid.ROAD_Y = 0.5
WorldGrid.ROAD_THICKNESS = 1.0
WorldGrid.SIDEWALK_HEIGHT = 0.65
WorldGrid.SIDEWALK_WIDTH = 9.0

-- 3 Đại lộ Đông - Tây (trải từ X = -340 đến X = +340)
WorldGrid.EW_ROADS = {
	{ id = "Road_Vinewood", name = "Vinewood Blvd", axis = "X", coord = -224, width = 32, min = -340, max = 340, lanes = 2 },
	{ id = "Road_Olympic",  name = "Olympic Fwy",   axis = "X", coord = -36,  width = 36, min = -340, max = 340, lanes = 4 },
	{ id = "Road_Vespucci", name = "Vespucci Blvd", axis = "X", coord = 148,  width = 32, min = -340, max = 340, lanes = 2 },
} :: { RoadDef }

-- 4 Đại lộ Bắc - Nam đối xứng gương qua X = 0 (trải từ Z = -240 đến Z = +164)
WorldGrid.NS_ROADS = {
	{ id = "Road_DelPerro",   name = "Del Perro Fwy",   axis = "Z", coord = -324, width = 32, min = -240, max = 164, lanes = 2 },
	{ id = "Road_SanAndreas", name = "San Andreas Ave", axis = "Z", coord = -110, width = 36, min = -240, max = 164, lanes = 4 },
	{ id = "Road_Alta",       name = "Alta St",         axis = "Z", coord = 110,  width = 36, min = -240, max = 164, lanes = 4 },
	{ id = "Road_Elgin",      name = "Elgin Ave",       axis = "Z", coord = 324,  width = 32, min = -240, max = 164, lanes = 2 },
} :: { RoadDef }

-- 6 Ô Đất Đô Thị Đối Xứng Khít Tuyệt Đối (0.000-stud gap với toàn bộ mặt đường xung quanh)
WorldGrid.PLOTS = {
	-- Hàng Bắc (Z từ -208 đến -54 => centerZ = -131, sizeZ = 154)
	{
		id = "Plot_D1",
		district = "ROCKFORD HILLS",
		subtitle = "Khu Biệt Thự & Luxury Boutique (Giai đoạn 3)",
		center = Vector3.new(-218, 0, -131),
		size = Vector3.new(180, 1, 154),
		reservedForPhase = 3,
	},
	{
		id = "Plot_D2",
		district = "PILLBOX HILL",
		subtitle = "Tháp Tài Chính Maze Bank Downtown (Giai đoạn 3)",
		center = Vector3.new(0, 0, -131),
		size = Vector3.new(184, 1, 154),
		reservedForPhase = 3,
	},
	{
		id = "Plot_D3",
		district = "DOWNTOWN VINEWOOD",
		subtitle = "Đại Lộ Điện Ảnh & Studio (Giai đoạn 3)",
		center = Vector3.new(218, 0, -131),
		size = Vector3.new(180, 1, 154),
		reservedForPhase = 3,
	},

	-- Hàng Nam (Z từ -18 đến +132 => centerZ = +57, sizeZ = 150)
	{
		id = "Plot_C1",
		district = "DEL PERRO",
		subtitle = "Los Santos Customs & Cửa Hàng Ven Biển (Giai đoạn 3-4)",
		center = Vector3.new(-218, 0, 57),
		size = Vector3.new(180, 1, 150),
		reservedForPhase = 3,
	},
	{
		id = "Plot_C2",
		district = "LEGION SQUARE",
		subtitle = "Quảng Trường Trung Tâm & Điểm Xuất Phát (Giai đoạn 1)",
		center = Vector3.new(0, 0, 57),
		size = Vector3.new(184, 1, 150),
		reservedForPhase = 1,
	},
	{
		id = "Plot_C3",
		district = "MISSION ROW",
		subtitle = "Sở Cảnh Sát LSPD & Khu Thương Mại (Giai đoạn 3-5)",
		center = Vector3.new(218, 0, 57),
		size = Vector3.new(180, 1, 150),
		reservedForPhase = 3,
	},
} :: { PlotDef }

WorldGrid.ZONES = {
	VINEWOOD_Z_MAX = -240,
	BEACH_BOARDWALK_Z_MIN = 164,
	BEACH_SAND_Z_MIN = 186,
	OCEAN_WATER_Z_MIN = 250,
}

-- Điểm hồi sinh chính giữa Quảng Trường Trung Tâm Legion Square (nhìn thẳng về Downtown & Đồi Vinewood)
WorldGrid.SPAWN_POS = Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 92)

function WorldGrid.getLocationInfo(pos: Vector3): (string, string)
	local district = "LOS SANTOS"

	if pos.Z < WorldGrid.ZONES.VINEWOOD_Z_MAX then
		district = "VINEWOOD HILLS"
	elseif pos.Z >= WorldGrid.ZONES.OCEAN_WATER_Z_MIN then
		district = "PACIFIC OCEAN"
	elseif pos.Z >= WorldGrid.ZONES.BEACH_BOARDWALK_Z_MIN then
		district = "VESPUCCI BEACH"
	else
		for _, plot in ipairs(WorldGrid.PLOTS) do
			local hx = plot.size.X * 0.5 + 18
			local hz = plot.size.Z * 0.5 + 18
			if math.abs(pos.X - plot.center.X) <= hx and math.abs(pos.Z - plot.center.Z) <= hz then
				district = plot.district
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local bestStreet = "San Andreas State"
	local bestDist = math.huge
	local secondStreet: string? = nil

	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.EW_ROADS) do
		if pos.X >= r.min - 24 and pos.X <= r.max + 24 then
			local d = math.abs(pos.Z - r.coord)
			if d < bestDist then
				if bestDist < 28 then
					secondStreet = bestStreet
				end
				bestDist = d
				bestStreet = r.name
			elseif d < 28 and r.name ~= bestStreet then
				secondStreet = r.name
			end
		end
	end

	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.NS_ROADS) do
		if pos.Z >= r.min - 24 and pos.Z <= r.max + 24 then
			local d = math.abs(pos.X - r.coord)
			if d < bestDist then
				if bestDist < 28 then
					secondStreet = bestStreet
				end
				bestDist = d
				bestStreet = r.name
			elseif d < 28 and r.name ~= bestStreet then
				secondStreet = r.name
			end
		end
	end

	if secondStreet and bestDist < 24 then
		return district, string.format("%s & %s", bestStreet, secondStreet)
	end
	return district, bestStreet
end

return WorldGrid

DestructionManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	DestructionManager.luau
	Hệ thống Máu Ẩn (PartHealth) & Tự Động Vỡ Vật Lý (Auto-Shatter Engine):
	- Mọi khối vật lý có Destructible = true (tường gạch, dải phân cách K-Rail, cọc tiêu, bờ kè đá,
	  tượng đài, và toàn bộ vỏ/kính/đèn xe hơi) đều mang máu ẩn PartHealth.
	- Khi bị XE ĐỤNG hoặc BỊ SÚNG BẮN đều trừ PartHealth, sẫm màu / nứt kính dần.
	- Ngay khi PartHealth <= 0: TỰ ĐỘNG VỠ TUNG thành các mảnh vật lý 3D văng theo hướng lực tác động,
	  đồng thời kích hoạt sập dây chuyền cho các hàng gạch nằm chồng phía trên (StructuralRow).
]]

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local DestructionManager = {}

local MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS = 180
local activeDebrisCount = 0

local function getDebrisFolder(): Folder
	local f = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris") :: Folder?
	if not f then
		local created = Instance.new("Folder")
		created.Name = "LosSantos_Debris"
		created.Parent = Workspace
		f = created
	end
	return f :: Folder
end

local function spawnTrackedDebris(part: BasePart, lifetime: number)
	if activeDebrisCount >= MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS then
		local folder = getDebrisFolder()
		local children = folder:GetChildren()
		if #children > 0 then
			children[1]:Destroy()
			activeDebrisCount = math.max(0, activeDebrisCount - 1)
		end
	end
	activeDebrisCount += 1
	part.Parent = getDebrisFolder()
	task.delay(lifetime, function()
		if part.Parent then
			part:Destroy()
		end
		activeDebrisCount = math.max(0, activeDebrisCount - 1)
	end)
end

local function ensureBaseColorSaved(part: BasePart)
	if part:GetAttribute("_OrigR") == nil then
		part:SetAttribute("_OrigR", part.Color.R)
		part:SetAttribute("_OrigG", part.Color.G)
		part:SetAttribute("_OrigB", part.Color.B)
	end
end

local function getSavedBaseColor(part: BasePart): Color3
	local r = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("_OrigR")) or part.Color.R
	local g = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("_OrigG")) or part.Color.G
	local b = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("_OrigB")) or part.Color.B
	return Color3.new(r, g, b)
end

-- Tia mảnh vụn nhỏ văng ra mỗi khi đạn găm hoặc xe quệt trúng nhưng chưa vỡ hẳn
local function emitHitChip(hitPos: Vector3, basePart: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	if activeDebrisCount >= MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS then
		return
	end
	local chip = Instance.new("Part")
	chip.Name = "ImpactChip"
	chip.Size = Vector3.new(0.32, 0.24, 0.32)
	chip.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos)
	chip.Color = basePart.Color
	chip.Material = basePart.Material
	chip.Anchored = false
	chip.CanCollide = false
	chip.CanQuery = false
	chip.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.35 + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(8, 18), math.random(-10, 10))
	chip.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12))
	spawnTrackedDebris(chip, 1.8)
end

-- Vỡ kính / đèn thành hàng loạt mảnh kính trong suốt văng tứ phía
local function shatterGlassOrLight(part: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	local cf = part.CFrame
	local sz = part.Size
	local col = part.Color
	local mat = part.Material
	local transp = math.clamp(part.Transparency, 0.15, 0.55)

	part:Destroy()

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * sz.X * 0.75
		local oy = (math.random() - 0.5) * sz.Y * 0.75
		local oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * sz.Z * 0.75

		local shard = Instance.new("WedgePart")
		shard.Name = "GlassShard_" .. tostring(i)
		shard.Size = Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(sz.X * 0.28, 0.22, 1.3),
			math.clamp(sz.Y * 0.32, 0.22, 1.3),
			math.clamp(sz.Z * 0.28, 0.15, 1.1)
		)
		shard.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(ox, oy, oz) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 3, math.random() * 3, math.random() * 3)
		shard.Color = col
		shard.Material = mat
		shard.Transparency = transp
		shard.Anchored = false
		shard.CanCollide = true
		shard.CanQuery = false
		shard.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.65 + Vector3.new(math.random(-16, 16), math.random(6, 20), math.random(-16, 16))
		shard.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-18, 18), math.random(-18, 18), math.random(-18, 18))
		spawnTrackedDebris(shard, 4.5)
	end
end

-- Tách khối gạch / bê tông / đá thành 4 mảnh vỡ vật lý 3D văng tung toé
local function fractureWorldBlock(part: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	local cf = part.CFrame
	local sz = part.Size
	local col = getSavedBaseColor(part)
	local mat = part.Material
	local parentFolder = part.Parent
	local row = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("StructuralRow")) or 1
	local pos = part.Position

	part:Destroy()

	local subCount = if (sz.X * sz.Y * sz.Z) > 12 then 4 else 2
	for i = 1, subCount do
		local sxSign = if (i % 2 == 0) then 1 else -1
		local szSign = if i > 2 then 1 else -1
		local chunkSz = Vector3.new(
			math.max(0.45, sz.X * 0.46),
			math.max(0.42, sz.Y * 0.72),
			math.max(0.45, sz.Z * 0.46)
		)
		local localOff = Vector3.new(
			sxSign * sz.X * 0.22,
			(i % 2 == 0 and 0.1 or -0.1) * sz.Y,
			szSign * sz.Z * 0.22
		)

		local chunk = Instance.new("Part")
		chunk.Name = "RubbleChunk"
		chunk.Size = chunkSz
		chunk.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(localOff) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(-12, 12)), math.rad(math.random(-18, 18)), 0)
		chunk.Color = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18), 0.14)
		chunk.Material = mat
		chunk.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		chunk.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		chunk.Anchored = false
		chunk.CanCollide = true
		chunk.CanQuery = false
		chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.55
			+ Vector3.new(sxSign * math.random(6, 15), math.random(8, 22), szSign * math.random(6, 15))
		chunk.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(-14, 14), math.random(-10, 10))
		spawnTrackedDebris(chunk, 7.5)
	end

	-- Hiệu ứng sập dây chuyền cho các viên gạch nằm ngay bên trên (StructuralRow + 1)
	if parentFolder then
		local reachX = sz.X * 0.65 + 1.2
		local reachZ = sz.Z * 0.65 + 1.2
		for _, sib in ipairs(parentFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if sib:IsA("BasePart") and sib:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
				local sibRow = tonumber(sib:GetAttribute("StructuralRow")) or 1
				if sibRow == row + 1 then
					if math.abs(sib.Position.X - pos.X) <= reachX and math.abs(sib.Position.Z - pos.Z) <= reachZ then
						task.delay(0.08, function()
							if sib.Parent then
								local maxHp = tonumber(sib:GetAttribute("MaxPartHealth")) or 100
								DestructionManager.damagePart(sib, maxHp * 1.05, sib.Position, Vector3.new(0, -8, 0))
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Bung rời cánh cửa / nắp capo / cản xe khi hết máu ẩn
local function detachVehiclePanel(part: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	if part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or part.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
		shatterGlassOrLight(part, impulse)
		return
	end

	local parentFolder = part.Parent
	local weld = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("WeldConstraint")
	if weld then
		weld:Destroy()
	end

	-- Nếu là Cánh Cửa Xe (LeftDoor / RightDoor): tắt ProximityPrompt & cho các chi tiết gắn trên cửa bay theo cùng cánh cửa!
	if parentFolder then
		for _, sib in ipairs(parentFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if sib ~= part and sib:IsA("BasePart") then
				local sw = sib:FindFirstChildOfClass("WeldConstraint")
				if sw and sw.Part0 == part then
					local pr = sib:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
					if pr then
						pr.Enabled = false
						pr:Destroy()
					end
					sib:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
					sib.CanQuery = false
					spawnTrackedDebris(sib, 8.0)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	part:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.Massless = false
	part.Color = getSavedBaseColor(part):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32), 0.35)
	part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.5 + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(12, 24), math.random(-12, 12))
	part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-9, 9), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-9, 9))
	spawnTrackedDebris(part, 8.0)
end

-- Xử lý khói đen, lửa cháy & NỔ TUNG XE khi EngineHealth <= 0
function DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(car: Model, amount: number, originImpulse: Vector3?)
	if not car.Parent or car:GetAttribute("_Exploded") == true then
		return
	end
	local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
	if not chassis then
		return
	end

	local maxE = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxEngineHealth")) or 700
	local curE = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("EngineHealth")) or maxE
	local nextE = math.max(0, curE - amount)
	car:SetAttribute("EngineHealth", nextE)

	local ratio = nextE / maxE

	-- Dưới 55% máu động cơ: bốc khói xám dưới nắp capo
	local smoke = chassis:FindFirstChild("EngineSmoke") :: Smoke?
	if ratio <= 0.55 and not smoke then
		local s = Instance.new("Smoke")
		s.Name = "EngineSmoke"
		s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 118, 124)
		s.Opacity = 0.45
		s.RiseVelocity = 7
		s.Size = 3.5
		s.Parent = chassis
		smoke = s
	end

	-- Dưới 25% máu động cơ: khói đen đặc + bốc lửa cam chuẩn GTA V!
	if ratio <= 0.25 then
		if smoke then
			smoke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30)
			smoke.Opacity = 0.78
		end
		if not chassis:FindFirstChild("EngineFire") then
			local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
			fire.Name = "EngineFire"
			fire.Heat = 12
			fire.Size = 7
			fire.Parent = chassis
		end
	end

	-- Hết sạch máu động cơ => NỔ TUNG XE & PHÁ VỠ GẠCH ĐÁ XUNG QUANH!
	if nextE <= 0 then
		car:SetAttribute("_Exploded", true)
		local blastCenter = chassis.Position

		local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
		exp.Position = blastCenter
		exp.BlastRadius = 22
		exp.BlastPressure = 0 -- Tự tính lực văng mượt bằng DestructionManager
		exp.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
		exp.Parent = Workspace

		-- Hất tung người ngồi nếu còn trên ghế
		local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
		if seat and seat.Occupant then
			seat.Occupant.Sit = false
			seat.Occupant:TakeDamage(65)
		end

		-- Bung toàn bộ các mảnh vỏ xe còn lại và nhuộm cháy đen khung sườn
		for _, desc in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				if desc:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true then
					local outDir = (desc.Position - blastCenter)
					local unit = if outDir.Magnitude > 0.1 then outDir.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					detachVehiclePanel(desc, unit * 48 + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0))
				else
					desc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 25, 25)
					desc.Material = Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal
				end
			end
		end

		chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (originImpulse or Vector3.zero) * 0.2 + Vector3.new(0, 32, 0)
		chassis.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-4, 4), math.random(-5, 5), math.random(-4, 4))

		-- Sóng xung kích vụ nổ thổi vỡ gạch / cọc tiêu / dải phân cách xung quanh xe!
		DestructionManager.damageRadius(blastCenter, 20, 220, 58, car)

		Debris:AddItem(car, 10)
	end
end

-- Hàm trung tâm: Trừ máu ẩn (PartHealth) của bất kỳ Part nào khi bị ĐỤNG XE hoặc BỊ BẮN
function DestructionManager.damagePart(
	part: BasePart,
	amount: number,
	hitPos: Vector3?,
	impulseVec: Vector3?
): boolean
	if not part or not part.Parent or amount <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	-- Nếu bắn trực tiếp vào khung gầm/động cơ xe không phải vỏ rời => trừ thẳng EngineHealth!
	local parentCar = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if parentCar and parentCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true and part:GetAttribute("Destructible") ~= true then
		DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(parentCar, amount * 0.85, impulseVec)
		emitHitChip(hitPos or part.Position, part, impulseVec or Vector3.new(0, 12, 0))
		return false
	end

	if part:GetAttribute("Destructible") ~= true then
		return false
	end
	if part:GetAttribute("_Shattered") == true then
		return false
	end

	ensureBaseColorSaved(part)

	local maxHp = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("MaxPartHealth"))
		or tonumber(part:GetAttribute("MaxIntegrity"))
		or 100
	local curHp = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("PartHealth"))
		or tonumber(part:GetAttribute("Integrity"))
		or maxHp

	local nextHp = math.max(0, curHp - amount)
	part:SetAttribute("PartHealth", nextHp)
	part:SetAttribute("Integrity", nextHp)

	local impulse = impulseVec or Vector3.new(0, 14, 0)
	local impactPt = hitPos or part.Position

	-- Nếu thuộc xe hơi, truyền một phần chấn động vào động cơ xe
	if part:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true and parentCar and parentCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
		DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(parentCar, amount * 0.32, impulse)
	end

	if nextHp > 0 then
		-- Chưa hết máu ẩn: hiện vết sẫm màu / rạn kính & tia mảnh vụn nhỏ (KHÔNG hiện thanh máu thô!)
		emitHitChip(impactPt, part, impulse)
		local ratio = nextHp / math.max(1, maxHp)
		local origCol = getSavedBaseColor(part)

		if part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then
			part.Color = origCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(210, 230, 245), (1 - ratio) * 0.55)
			part.Transparency = math.clamp(0.18 + ratio * 0.25, 0.15, 0.5)
		elseif ratio <= 0.35 then
			part.Color = origCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 28), 0.36)
		elseif ratio <= 0.70 then
			part.Color = origCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36), 0.18)
		end
		return false
	end

	-- ĐÃ HẾT SẠCH MÁU ẨN (nextHp <= 0) => TỰ ĐỘNG VỠ TUNG!
	part:SetAttribute("_Shattered", true)

	if part:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true then
		detachVehiclePanel(part, impulse)
	elseif part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or part.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
		shatterGlassOrLight(part, impulse)
	else
		fractureWorldBlock(part, impulse)
	end

	return true
end

-- Phá huỷ vùng (dùng cho cả Va chạm Mũi Xe Tốc Độ Cao lẫn Vụ Nổ!)
function DestructionManager.damageRadius(
	center: Vector3,
	radius: number,
	maxDamage: number,
	forceMag: number,
	ignoreInstance: Instance?
): number
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local excludeList: { Instance } = { getDebrisFolder() }
	if ignoreInstance then
		table.insert(excludeList, ignoreInstance)
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludeList

	local hitParts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(center, radius, params)
	local brokenCount = 0

	for _, hp in ipairs(hitParts) do
		if hp:IsA("BasePart") then
			local delta = hp.Position - center
			local dist = delta.Magnitude
			local falloff = math.clamp(1 - (dist / (radius + 2.5)), 0.25, 1)
			local dir = if dist > 0.05 then (delta / dist) else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local dmg = maxDamage * falloff
			if DestructionManager.damagePart(hp, dmg, center + dir * math.min(dist, 1.5), dir * (forceMag * falloff)) then
				brokenCount += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return brokenCount
end

return DestructionManager

LSCustomsService.source:
--!strict
--[[
	LSCustomsService.luau
	================================================================================
	DỊCH VỤ ĐỘ XE LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS (Plot_C1) — CHỨC NĂNG THẬT 100%
	================================================================================
	• Quét liên tục 2 khoang cửa cuốn (`BayZone1` / `BayZone2` do module Plot_C1 dựng).
	• Xe GTA V chạy vào khoang -> đèn neon mặt sàn + đèn cầu ĐỎ chuyển XANH,
	  người chơi nhận gợi ý "[E] ĐỘ XE" (HUD riêng, không dùng ProximityPrompt mặc định).
	• Bảng độ xe cho phép:
	    1) SỬA CHỮA  ($250)  : hồi 100% máu ẩn mọi part + sơn lại màu gốc + đầy EngineHealth.
	    2) SƠN LẠI   ($500)  : đổi màu sơn thân xe theo bảng màu GTA V (lưu lại màu gốc mới).
	    3) TURBO     ($1500) : +8 MaxSpeed mỗi cấp (tối đa 3 cấp) — xe chạy nhanh hơn thật.
	• Trừ tiền qua `Cash` attribute + leaderstats, chống spam bằng cooldown 0.5s.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LSCustomsService = {}

local PRICE_REPAIR = 250
local PRICE_PAINT = 500
local PRICE_TURBO = 1500
local MAX_TURBO_LEVEL = 3
local ACTION_COOLDOWN = 0.5

local PAINT_PALETTE: { Color3 } = {
	Color3.fromRGB(206, 28, 36), -- Rosso Corsa
	Color3.fromRGB(249, 168, 24), -- Sunset Orange
	Color3.fromRGB(247, 214, 58), -- Race Yellow
	Color3.fromRGB(46, 176, 96), -- Emerald Green
	Color3.fromRGB(38, 124, 214), -- Electric Blue
	Color3.fromRGB(140, 78, 210), -- Midnight Purple
	Color3.fromRGB(232, 236, 242), -- Frost White
	Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 34), -- Matte Black
}

local BODY_ZONES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	Front = true,
	Rear = true,
	Top = true,
	Left = true,
	Right = true,
	Body = true,
}

type BayState = {
	zone: BasePart,
	center: Vector3,
	car: Model?,
	strip: BasePart?,
	lamp: BasePart?,
}

local remotesFolder: Instance? = nil
local hudRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local customsRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local bays: { BayState } = {}
local lastActionAt: { [Player]: number } = {}
local announced: { [Model]: boolean } = {}

local function findFirst(parent: Instance, name: string): Instance?
	local found = parent:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	return found
end

local function cashOf(player: Player): number
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cs = if ls then ls:FindFirstChild("Cash") else nil
	if cs and cs:IsA("IntValue") then
		return cs.Value
	end
	return tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 0
end

local function setCash(player: Player, value: number)
	local clamped = math.max(0, math.floor(value))
	player:SetAttribute("Cash", clamped)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cs = if ls then ls:FindFirstChild("Cash") else nil
	if cs and cs:IsA("IntValue") then
		cs.Value = clamped
	end
end

local function toast(player: Player, message: string, color: Color3)
	local remote = hudRemote
	if remote then
		remote:FireClient(player, { message = message, color = color })
	end
end

local function setBayLights(state: BayState, occupied: boolean)
	local color = if occupied then Color3.fromRGB(46, 224, 128) else Color3.fromRGB(220, 42, 42)
	local strip = state.strip
	if strip then
		strip.Color = color
	end
	local lamp = state.lamp
	if lamp then
		lamp.Color = color
		lamp.Material = if occupied then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Neon
	end
end

local function vehicleOfPlayer(player: Player): Model?
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local seat = if hum then hum.SeatPart else nil
	if not seat then
		return nil
	end
	local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if model and model:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
		return model
	end
	return nil
end

local function insideBay(state: BayState, car: Model): boolean
	local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis")
	local prim = if chassis and chassis:IsA("BasePart") then chassis else car.PrimaryPart
	if not prim then
		return false
	end
	local p = prim.Position
	local z = state.zone.Position
	local sx = state.zone.Size.X * 0.5
	local sz = state.zone.Size.Z * 0.5
	return math.abs(p.X - z.X) <= sx + 1.5 and math.abs(p.Z - z.Z) <= sz + 1.5
end

local function collectVehicles(): { Model }
	local list: { Model } = {}
	local roots = { workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos"), workspace }
	for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
		if root then
			local fleet = root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles", true)
			if fleet then
				for _, child in ipairs(fleet:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Model") and child:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
						table.insert(list, child)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function nearbyPlayers(center: Vector3, radius: number): { Player }
	local out: { Player } = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
			if (hrp.Position - center).Magnitude <= radius then
				table.insert(out, player)
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function pushPrompt(state: BayState, bayIndex: number)
	local remote = customsRemote
	if not remote then
		return
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(nearbyPlayers(state.center, 46)) do
		local inCar = vehicleOfPlayer(player) ~= nil
		remote:FireClient(player, {
			kind = "prompt",
			bay = bayIndex,
			visible = state.car ~= nil,
			vehicle = if state.car then tostring(state.car:GetAttribute("VehicleDisplayName") or state.car.Name) else "",
			inCar = inCar,
		})
	end
end

local function describeCar(car: Model): { [string]: any }
	local totalHp, maxHp = 0, 0
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if bodyFolder then
		for _, ch in ipairs(bodyFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
				totalHp += tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("PartHealth")) or 0
				maxHp += tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("MaxPartHealth")) or 0
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		name = tostring(car:GetAttribute("VehicleDisplayName") or car.Name),
		turbo = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("TurboLevel")) or 0,
		maxSpeed = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")) or 0,
		damagePct = if maxHp > 0 then math.floor((1 - totalHp / maxHp) * 100) else 0,
		engine = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("EngineHealth")) or 0,
		prices = { repair = PRICE_REPAIR, paint = PRICE_PAINT, turbo = PRICE_TURBO },
	}
end

local function repairCar(car: Model): number
	local repaired = 0
	for _, ch in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
			local maxHp = tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("MaxPartHealth")) or tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("MaxIntegrity")) or 0
			if maxHp > 0 then
				ch:SetAttribute("PartHealth", maxHp)
				ch:SetAttribute("Integrity", maxHp)
				repaired += 1
			end
			local r = tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("_OrigR"))
			local g = tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("_OrigG"))
			local b = tonumber(ch:GetAttribute("_OrigB"))
			if r and g and b then
				ch.Color = Color3.new(r, g, b)
			end
		end
	end
	local maxEngine = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxEngineHealth")) or 700
	car:SetAttribute("EngineHealth", maxEngine)
	car:SetAttribute("_Exploded", false)
	return repaired
end

local function paintCar(car: Model, color: Color3): number
	local painted = 0
	for _, ch in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true then
			local zone = tostring(ch:GetAttribute("DamageZone") or "Body")
			if BODY_ZONES[zone] == true and ch.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then
				ch.Color = color
				ch:SetAttribute("_OrigR", color.R)
				ch:SetAttribute("_OrigG", color.G)
				ch:SetAttribute("_OrigB", color.B)
				painted += 1
			end
		end
	end
	local nextIndex = (tonumber(car:GetAttribute("PaintIndex")) or 0) % #PAINT_PALETTE + 1
	car:SetAttribute("PaintIndex", nextIndex)
	car:SetAttribute("PaintName", string.format("Màu #%d", nextIndex))
	return painted
end

local function turboCar(car: Model): boolean
	local level = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("TurboLevel")) or 0
	if level >= MAX_TURBO_LEVEL then
		return false
	end
	local maxSpeed = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")) or 92
	car:SetAttribute("TurboLevel", level + 1)
	car:SetAttribute("MaxSpeed", math.min(140, maxSpeed + 8))
	return true
end

local function bayIndexOfCar(car: Model): number
	for i, state in ipairs(bays) do
		if state.car == car then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function handleAction(player: Player, payload: any)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local action = tostring(payload.action or "")
	local bayIndex = tonumber(payload.bay) or 0
	local state = bays[bayIndex]
	if not state then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local lastAt = lastActionAt[player] or 0
	if now - lastAt < ACTION_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastActionAt[player] = now

	local car = state.car
	local remote = customsRemote
	if not remote then
		return
	end

	if action == "open" then
		if not car then
			remote:FireClient(player, { kind = "result", ok = false, message = "Khoang này đang trống — hãy lái xe vào!" })
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local driver = vehicleOfPlayer(player)
		local closeEnough = hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") and (hrp.Position - state.center).Magnitude <= 40
		if driver ~= car and not closeEnough then
			remote:FireClient(player, { kind = "result", ok = false, message = "Bạn phải đứng gần khoang độ xe này!" })
			return
		end
		remote:FireClient(player, {
			kind = "menu",
			bay = bayIndex,
			car = describeCar(car),
			cash = cashOf(player),
		})
		return
	end

	if action == "close" then
		remote:FireClient(player, { kind = "closed" })
		return
	end

	if not car then
		remote:FireClient(player, { kind = "result", ok = false, message = "Không có xe trong khoang!" })
		return
	end

	local price = if action == "repair" then PRICE_REPAIR elseif action == "paint" then PRICE_PAINT elseif action == "turbo" then PRICE_TURBO else -1
	if price < 0 then
		return
	end

	local cash = cashOf(player)
	if cash < price then
		remote:FireClient(player, { kind = "result", ok = false, message = string.format("Không đủ tiền! Cần $%d (bạn có $%d)", price, cash) })
		return
	end

	local okMessage = ""
	if action == "repair" then
		local count = repairCar(car)
		okMessage = string.format("Đã sửa chữa %d chi tiết — xe như mới!", count)
	elseif action == "paint" then
		local target = PAINT_PALETTE[(tonumber(car:GetAttribute("PaintIndex")) or 0) % #PAINT_PALETTE + 1]
		local count = paintCar(car, target)
		okMessage = string.format("Đã sơn lại %d tấm vỏ xe — lớp sơn tan chảy!", count)
	else
		if turboCar(car) then
			okMessage = string.format("Nâng cấp Turbo cấp %d — tốc độ tối đa %d!", tonumber(car:GetAttribute("TurboLevel")) or 1, math.floor(tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")) or 0))
		else
			remote:FireClient(player, { kind = "result", ok = false, message = "Xe đã đạt Turbo cấp 3 tối đa!" })
			return
		end
	end

	setCash(player, cash - price)
	remote:FireClient(player, {
		kind = "result",
		ok = true,
		action = action,
		message = okMessage,
		cash = cashOf(player),
		car = describeCar(car),
	})
	toast(player, "Los Santos Customs: " .. okMessage .. string.format(" (-$%d)", price), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248))
end

function LSCustomsService.init(remotesFolderRef: Instance, hudRemoteRef: RemoteEvent, losSantosRoot: Instance)
	remotesFolder = remotesFolderRef
	hudRemote = hudRemoteRef

	local existing = remotesFolderRef:FindFirstChild("LSCustoms")
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		customsRemote = existing
	else
		local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		created.Name = "LSCustoms"
		created.Parent = remotesFolderRef
		customsRemote = created
	end

	bays = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local zoneInstance = findFirst(losSantosRoot, "BayZone" .. i)
		if zoneInstance and zoneInstance:IsA("BasePart") then
			local centerAttr = zoneInstance:GetAttribute("BayCenter")
			local center = if typeof(centerAttr) == "Vector3" then centerAttr else zoneInstance.Position - Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
			local strip = findFirst(losSantosRoot, "BayStatusStrip" .. i)
			local lamp = findFirst(losSantosRoot, "BayStatusLamp" .. i)
			bays[i] = {
				zone = zoneInstance,
				center = center :: Vector3,
				car = nil,
				strip = if strip and strip:IsA("BasePart") then strip else nil,
				lamp = if lamp and lamp:IsA("BasePart") then lamp else nil,
			}
			setBayLights(bays[i], false)
		end
	end

	local remote = customsRemote
	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(handleAction)

	-- Vòng quét trạng thái khoang (0.35s) — ổn định hơn Touched và không bỏ sót xe đứng yên
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.35)
			local vehicles = collectVehicles()
			for i, state in ipairs(bays) do
				local newCar: Model? = nil
				for _, car in ipairs(vehicles) do
					if insideBay(state, car) then
						newCar = car
						break
					end
				end
				if newCar ~= state.car then
					state.car = newCar
					setBayLights(state, newCar ~= nil)
					if newCar then
						pushPrompt(state, i)
					end
				end
				pushPrompt(state, i)
			end
			-- Chào mừng tài xế vừa lái xe vào khoang
			for _, state in ipairs(bays) do
				local car = state.car
				if car and not announced[car] then
					announced[car] = true
					local idx = bayIndexOfCar(car)
					local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat")
					local occupant = if seat and seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then seat.Occupant else nil
					local driverPlayer = if occupant then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent) else nil
					if driverPlayer then
						toast(driverPlayer, string.format("LS CUSTOMS: Xe đã vào Khoang %d — bấm [E] để độ xe!", idx), Color3.fromRGB(46, 224, 128))
					end
				end
			end
			for car in pairs(announced) do
				if not car.Parent then
					announced[car] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	print(string.format("[LSCustomsService] Đã kích hoạt %d khoang độ xe (Bay 1 & Bay 2).", #bays))
end

return LSCustomsService

VehicleManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	VehicleManager.luau
	Điều khiển vật lý lái xe GTA V mượt mà + Xử lý VA CHẠM TỐC ĐỘ CAO trừ máu ẩn (PartHealth):
	- Khi xe tông vào cọc tiêu, dải phân cách K-Rail, tường gạch, bờ kè hoặc xe khác:
	  + Khối bị tông mất máu ẩn theo động lượng -> hết máu tự vỡ tung thành mảnh rời!
	  + Chính cản trước / đèn pha / nắp capo / kính chắn gió của xe cũng mất máu ẩn -> hết máu bung rơi khỏi xe!
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local VehicleBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Vehicles"):WaitForChild("VehicleBuilder"))
local DestructionManager = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DestructionManager"))

local VehicleManager = {}

local trackedCars: { [Model]: boolean } = {}
local partHitCooldown: { [BasePart]: number } = {}
local carSelfHitCooldown: { [Model]: number } = {}

local PRESET_CYCLE = {
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.CrimsonBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.ObsidianGauntlet,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.MidnightBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.SunsetComet,
}
local playerCarIndex = 0

local function pickVehicleZonePart(car: Model, zone: string): BasePart?
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if not bodyFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local candidates: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(bodyFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
			local z = tostring(ch:GetAttribute("DamageZone") or "")
			if z == zone or (zone == "Front" and z == "Glass") then
				table.insert(candidates, ch)
			end
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
end

local function updateBrakeLights(car: Model, braking: boolean)
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if not bodyFolder then
		return
	end
	local col = if braking then Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65) else Color3.fromRGB(175, 22, 30)
	for _, nm in ipairs({ "LeftTaillight", "RightTaillight" }) do
		local tl = bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(nm)
		if tl and tl:IsA("BasePart") then
			tl.Color = col
		end
	end
end

local function setCabinLight(car: Model, active: boolean)
	local interior = car:FindFirstChild("InteriorDetails")
	local dome = if interior then interior:FindFirstChild("CabinDomeLight") else nil
	if dome and dome:IsA("BasePart") then
		dome.Material = if active then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		local pl = dome:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
		if pl then
			pl.Brightness = if active then 1.65 else 0
		end
	end
end

-- Diễn hoạt xoay mở / đóng cánh cửa quanh bản lề trước (LeftDoorHinge / RightDoorHinge)
function VehicleManager.animateDoor(
	car: Model,
	tag: "Left" | "Right",
	angleDeg: number,
	duration: number,
	easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?
)
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	local doorPart = if bodyFolder then bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(tag .. "Door") else nil
	if not doorPart then
		return -- Cánh cửa đã bị đâm / bắn văng khỏi xe!
	end

	local hinge = car:FindFirstChild(tag .. "DoorHinge")
	local weld = if hinge then hinge:FindFirstChild("DoorHingeWeld") :: Weld? else nil
	if not hinge or not weld then
		return
	end

	local cx = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("ClosedX")) or 0
	local cy = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("ClosedY")) or 0
	local cz = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("ClosedZ")) or 0
	local sideSign = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("SideSign")) or -1

	local targetC0 = CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz) * CFrame.Angles(0, sideSign * math.rad(angleDeg), 0)
	setCabinLight(car, angleDeg > 4)

	TweenService:Create(
		weld,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ C0 = targetC0 }
	):Play()
end

local function wireDoorAndSeat(car: Model, chassis: BasePart, tag: "Left" | "Right", seatObj: BasePart)
	local sideSign = if tag == "Left" then -1 else 1
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	local handle = if bodyFolder then bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(tag .. "OuterDoorHandle") else nil
	local prompt = if handle then handle:FindFirstChild("EnterDoorPrompt") :: ProximityPrompt? else nil

	local animToken = 0
	local enteringViaPrompt = false
	local lastOccupant: Humanoid? = nil

	local function getOccupant(): Humanoid?
		if seatObj:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
			return seatObj.Occupant
		elseif seatObj:IsA("Seat") then
			return seatObj.Occupant
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function sitHumanoid(hum: Humanoid)
		if seatObj:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
			seatObj:Sit(hum)
		elseif seatObj:IsA("Seat") then
			seatObj:Sit(hum)
		end
	end

	-- 1) Khi bấm phím [F] cạnh tay nắm cửa -> Mở rộng cửa 64° -> Bước vào ngồi -> Kéo đóng cửa!
	if prompt then
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if getOccupant() ~= nil or enteringViaPrompt then
				return
			end
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
			if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.SeatPart ~= nil or not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
				return
			end

			enteringViaPrompt = true
			animToken += 1
			local myTok = animToken
			prompt.Enabled = false

			-- Bước 1: Tung cánh cửa mở rộng 64° + bật đèn trần ca-bin
			VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 64, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)

			-- Đưa nhân vật đứng ngay sát bậc cửa đang mở, quay mặt vào khoang lái
			local standPos = (chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(sideSign * 5.05, 0.55, 0.25)).Position
			local seatWorld = seatObj.Position
			hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(standPos, Vector3.new(seatWorld.X, standPos.Y, seatWorld.Z))

			-- Bước 2: Sau 0.22s khi cửa đã hé rộng, đặt nhân vật ngồi êm vào ghế đua
			task.delay(0.22, function()
				if animToken ~= myTok or not car.Parent then
					enteringViaPrompt = false
					return
				end
				if hum.Health > 0 and getOccupant() == nil then
					sitHumanoid(hum)
				end

				-- Bước 3: Ngồi yên trong ghế xong -> kéo cánh cửa sập đóng lại!
				task.delay(0.34, function()
					enteringViaPrompt = false
					if animToken == myTok and car.Parent then
						VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 0, 0.30, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Hạ nhẹ tư thế ngồi SeatWeld xuống đệm ghế đua âm sàn (-0.34 stud) để tóc cao R15 tuyệt đối không lòi qua mui xe!
	seatObj.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
		if ch.Name == "SeatWeld" and ch:IsA("Weld") then
			ch.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.34, 0.10) * ch.C0
		end
	end)

	-- 2) Theo dõi khi ngồi trực tiếp (chạm ghế) HOẶC khi nhảy ra khỏi xe (Space) -> Tự động mở & đóng cửa!
	seatObj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
		pcall(function()
			chassis:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end)

		local occ = getOccupant()
		if occ ~= nil then
			lastOccupant = occ
			if prompt then
				prompt.Enabled = false
			end
			if not enteringViaPrompt then
				animToken += 1
				local myTok = animToken
				VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 56, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				task.delay(0.26, function()
					if animToken == myTok and car.Parent then
						VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 0, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			-- Người chơi vừa bước xuống xe -> Mở bung cửa 62°, đặt nhân vật ra cạnh cửa thoáng đãng rồi khép cửa lại!
			if prompt and prompt.Parent then
				prompt.Enabled = true
			end
			animToken += 1
			local myTok = animToken
			VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 62, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)

			local prevHum = lastOccupant
			lastOccupant = nil
			if prevHum and prevHum.Parent then
				local prevChar = prevHum.Parent
				local prevHrp = prevChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if prevHrp and prevHrp:IsA("BasePart") then
					task.defer(function()
						if prevHrp.Parent and chassis.Parent then
							local exitCF = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(sideSign * 5.75, 0.65, 0.30)
							prevHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
								exitCF.Position,
								exitCF.Position + chassis.CFrame.LookVector
							)
						end
					end)
				end
			end

			task.delay(0.55, function()
				if animToken == myTok and car.Parent then
					VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 0, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

function VehicleManager.registerCar(car: Model)
	if trackedCars[car] then
		return
	end
	trackedCars[car] = true

	local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
	local driverSeat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
	local passSeat = car:FindFirstChild("PassengerSeat") :: Seat?
	if chassis then
		pcall(function()
			chassis:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end)
		if driverSeat then
			wireDoorAndSeat(car, chassis, "Left", driverSeat)
		end
		if passSeat then
			wireDoorAndSeat(car, chassis, "Right", passSeat)
		end
	end
end

function VehicleManager.spawnForPlayer(player: Player): Model?
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end

	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos")
	local fleet = if root then root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles") else nil
	local targetParent: Instance = fleet or Workspace

	-- Xoá xe cá nhân cũ của người chơi nếu còn để tránh rác map
	local oldTag = "PersonalCar_" .. tostring(player.UserId)
	for carModel in pairs(trackedCars) do
		if carModel.Parent and carModel:GetAttribute("OwnerTag") == oldTag then
			carModel:Destroy()
			trackedCars[carModel] = nil
		end
	end

	playerCarIndex = (playerCarIndex % #PRESET_CYCLE) + 1
	local preset = PRESET_CYCLE[playerCarIndex]

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		flatLook = flatLook.Unit
	end

	local spawnPos = hrp.Position + flatLook * 13 + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local spawnCF = CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, spawnPos + flatLook)
	local car = VehicleBuilder.spawn(targetParent, spawnCF, preset)
	car:SetAttribute("OwnerTag", oldTag)
	VehicleManager.registerCar(car)
	return car
end

function VehicleManager.init()
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos")
	if root then
		local fleet = root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles")
		if not fleet then
			fleet = VehicleBuilder.spawnDefaultFleet(root)
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(fleet:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") and child:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
				VehicleManager.registerCar(child)
			end
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_dt)
		local now = os.clock()

		-- Dọn bảng cooldown cũ định kỳ
		for p, expTime in pairs(partHitCooldown) do
			if not p.Parent or now > expTime then
				partHitCooldown[p] = nil
			end
		end

		for car in pairs(trackedCars) do
			if not car.Parent or car:GetAttribute("_Exploded") == true then
				trackedCars[car] = nil
				continue
			end

			local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
			local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
			local vf = if chassis then chassis:FindFirstChild("DriveVectorForce") :: VectorForce? else nil
			local av = if chassis then chassis:FindFirstChild("SteerAngularVelocity") :: AngularVelocity? else nil

			if not chassis or not seat or not vf or not av then
				continue
			end

			local vel = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local speed = vel.Magnitude
			car:SetAttribute("CurrentMPH", math.floor(speed * 1.15))

			local cf = chassis.CFrame
			local flatFwd = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
			if flatFwd.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				flatFwd = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			else
				flatFwd = flatFwd.Unit
			end
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
			if flatRight.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				flatRight = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			else
				flatRight = flatRight.Unit
			end

			local fwdSpeed = vel:Dot(flatFwd)
			local latSpeed = vel:Dot(flatRight)
			local mass = chassis.AssemblyMass
			local maxSpeed = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")) or 92

			if seat.Occupant then
				local throttle = seat.ThrottleFloat
				local steer = seat.SteerFloat

				-- Lực kéo động cơ + Phanh + Lực bám ngang chống trượt bánh lố
				local driveF = Vector3.zero
				if math.abs(throttle) > 0.04 then
					local targetSpd = if throttle > 0 then (throttle * maxSpeed) else (throttle * maxSpeed * 0.45)
					local gain = if (throttle * fwdSpeed < -2) then 7.2 else 4.4 -- Phanh gấp ăn hơn!
					driveF = flatFwd * ((targetSpd - fwdSpeed) * mass * gain)
				else
					driveF = -flatFwd * (fwdSpeed * mass * 0.95)
				end

				local gripF = -flatRight * (latSpeed * mass * 8.2)
				vf.Force = driveF + gripF

				-- Đánh lái mượt tỉ lệ theo tốc độ lăn bánh
				local moveRatio = math.clamp(math.abs(fwdSpeed) / 9.0, 0, 1)
				local revSign = if fwdSpeed < -1.5 then -1 else 1
				av.MaxTorque = mass * 520
				av.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -steer * 2.45 * moveRatio * revSign, 0)

				updateBrakeLights(car, throttle < -0.1)
			else
				-- Khi không có người lái: hãm trôi tự nhiên để xe đậu đằm trên dốc/lề đường
				vf.Force = -Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * (mass * 2.4)
				av.MaxTorque = 0
				updateBrakeLights(car, false)
			end

			-- QUÉT VA CHẠM TỐC ĐỘ CAO: Xe đụng khối có máu ẩn -> Trừ PartHealth -> Hết máu tự vỡ!
			if speed >= 13.5 then
				local goingForward = fwdSpeed >= -1.0
				local zoneOffsetZ = if goingForward then -8.15 else 8.15
				local zoneName = if goingForward then "Front" else "Rear"
				local sweepCF = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.55, zoneOffsetZ)

				local params = OverlapParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				local debFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if debFolder then { car, debFolder } else { car }

				local hits = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(sweepCF, Vector3.new(7.5, 2.5, 2.4), params)
				local hitSolidObstacle = false

				for _, hp in ipairs(hits) do
					if hp:IsA("BasePart") then
						if hp:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
							if not partHitCooldown[hp] then
								partHitCooldown[hp] = now + 0.16
								hitSolidObstacle = true
								local impactDmg = speed * 2.35
								local pushVec = vel * 1.15 + Vector3.new(0, 14, 0)
								DestructionManager.damagePart(hp, impactDmg, hp.Position, pushVec)
							end
						elseif hp.CanCollide and (hp.Position.Y + hp.Size.Y * 0.5) > (cf.Position.Y - 0.35) then
							-- Va vào vách núi / tường cứng cao hơn bậc vỉa hè
							hitSolidObstacle = true
						end
					end
				end

				-- Phản lực làm móp / vỡ đèn pha / cản xe / nắp capo của chính chiếc xe đang tông!
				if hitSolidObstacle and (now > (carSelfHitCooldown[car] or 0)) then
					carSelfHitCooldown[car] = now + 0.22
					local selfPanel = pickVehicleZonePart(car, zoneName)
					if selfPanel then
						DestructionManager.damagePart(
							selfPanel,
							speed * 0.58,
							selfPanel.Position,
							-flatFwd * (speed * 0.35) + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
						)
					else
						DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(car, speed * 0.65, vel)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return VehicleManager

WeaponManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	WeaponManager.luau
	Cấp vũ khí GTA V (Pistol 9mm & Carbine Rifle) cho người chơi để kiểm thử & chiến đấu:
	- Bắn trúng bất kỳ Part nào có máu ẩn (tường gạch, bờ kè, cọc tiêu, dải phân cách, kính/vỏ xe)
	  đều trừ PartHealth thông qua DestructionManager -> hết máu ẩn là TỰ VỠ!
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local DestructionManager = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DestructionManager"))

local WeaponManager = {}

local WEAPON_SPECS = {
	["Pistol 9mm"] = {
		damage = 38,
		cooldown = 0.16,
		range = 300,
		impulse = 36,
		isRifle = false,
	},
	["Carbine Rifle"] = {
		damage = 30,
		cooldown = 0.095,
		range = 380,
		impulse = 44,
		isRifle = true,
	},
}

local lastShotAt: { [Player]: number } = {}

local function buildWeaponTool(toolName: string, isRifle: boolean): Tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = toolName
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool:SetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon", true)
	tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire", isRifle)
	tool:SetAttribute("FireCooldown", if isRifle then 0.10 else 0.17)

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = if isRifle then Vector3.new(0.32, 0.95, 0.45) else Vector3.new(0.28, 0.82, 0.38)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 29, 36)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	handle.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Parent = tool

	-- Thân súng & Nòng súng chi tiết hàn cố định vào Handle
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "ReceiverSlide"
	body.Size = if isRifle then Vector3.new(0.34, 0.42, 2.55) else Vector3.new(0.30, 0.34, 1.25)
	body.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.44, if isRifle then -0.85 else -0.36)
	body.Color = if isRifle then Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 48) else Color3.fromRGB(52, 58, 68)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.Massless = true
	body.Parent = tool

	local wc1 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	wc1.Part0 = handle
	wc1.Part1 = body
	wc1.Parent = body

	local muzzle = Instance.new("Part")
	muzzle.Name = "Muzzle"
	muzzle.Size = Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.35)
	muzzle.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.46, if isRifle then -2.25 else -1.08)
	muzzle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26)
	muzzle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	muzzle.CanCollide = false
	muzzle.Massless = true
	muzzle.Parent = tool

	local wc2 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	wc2.Part0 = handle
	wc2.Part1 = muzzle
	wc2.Parent = muzzle

	if isRifle then
		local mag = Instance.new("Part")
		mag.Name = "Magazine"
		mag.Size = Vector3.new(0.24, 0.78, 0.36)
		mag.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.05, -0.78) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(14), 0, 0)
		mag.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
		mag.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		mag.CanCollide = false
		mag.Massless = true
		mag.Parent = tool
		local wc3 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		wc3.Part0 = handle
		wc3.Part1 = mag
		wc3.Parent = mag
	end

	return tool
end

local function giveLoadout(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5)
	if not backpack then
		return
	end
	for _, nm in ipairs({ "Pistol 9mm", "Carbine Rifle" }) do
		if not backpack:FindFirstChild(nm) then
			local t = buildWeaponTool(nm, nm == "Carbine Rifle")
			t.Parent = backpack
		end
	end
end

function WeaponManager.init(remotesFolder: Instance)
	local fireRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponFire") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not fireRemote then
		local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		created.Name = "WeaponFire"
		created.Parent = remotesFolder
		fireRemote = created
	end
	local activeFireRemote = fireRemote :: RemoteEvent

	local function hookPlayer(player: Player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.15)
			giveLoadout(player)
		end)
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(giveLoadout, player)
		end
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookPlayer(p)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		lastShotAt[p] = nil
	end)

	activeFireRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, originPos, aimPos)
		if typeof(originPos) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(aimPos) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end

		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if not tool or tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") ~= true then
			return
		end

		local spec = WEAPON_SPECS[tool.Name]
		if not spec then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastShotAt[player] or 0) < (spec.cooldown * 0.75) then
			return
		end
		lastShotAt[player] = now

		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not hrp or (originPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude > 22 then
			return
		end

		local dirVec = aimPos - originPos
		if dirVec.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			return
		end
		local rayDir = dirVec.Unit * spec.range

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local deb = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if deb then { char, deb } else { char }

		local result = Workspace:Raycast(originPos, rayDir, params)
		if result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			local hitPart = result.Instance
			local hitModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local hitHum = if hitModel then hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil

			if hitHum and hitModel ~= char then
				hitHum:TakeDamage(spec.damage * 0.7)
				activeFireRemote:FireClient(player, "hit", false)
			else
				local shattered = DestructionManager.damagePart(
					hitPart,
					spec.damage,
					result.Position,
					dirVec.Unit * spec.impulse + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
				)
				if hitPart:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true or shattered or (hitModel and hitModel:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true) then
					activeFireRemote:FireClient(player, "hit", shattered)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return WeaponManager

Server.source:
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local CityFoundation = require(Shared:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("CityFoundation"))
local DistrictRegistry = require(Shared:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("DistrictRegistry"))
local VehicleManager = require(script:WaitForChild("VehicleManager"))
local WeaponManager = require(script:WaitForChild("WeaponManager"))
local LSCustomsService = require(script:WaitForChild("LSCustomsService"))

-- Tạo thư mục RemoteEvents phục vụ HUD, Xe & Vũ khí GTA V
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GtaRemotes")
if not remotesFolder then
	local createdFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	createdFolder.Name = "GtaRemotes"
	createdFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	remotesFolder = createdFolder
end
local activeRemotes = remotesFolder :: Instance

local hudRemote = activeRemotes:FindFirstChild("HudAction") :: RemoteEvent?
if not hudRemote then
	local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	created.Name = "HudAction"
	created.Parent = activeRemotes
	hudRemote = created
end
local activeHudRemote = hudRemote :: RemoteEvent

if not activeRemotes:FindFirstChild("WeaponFire") then
	local wf = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	wf.Name = "WeaponFire"
	wf.Parent = activeRemotes
end

-- 1. Dựng Nền Thành Phố ghép khối có máu ẩn + Tự động nạp mọi Công Trình Đa-Agent trong World/Modules
local losSantosRoot = CityFoundation.build(false)
DistrictRegistry.buildAll(losSantosRoot)

-- 2. Khởi chạy Đội Xe Hơi GTA V (vật lý lái + đụng xe trừ máu ẩn PartHealth) & Vũ Khí bắn vỡ khối
VehicleManager.init()
WeaponManager.init(activeRemotes)

-- 3. Kích hoạt dịch vụ ĐỘ XE THẬT của Los Santos Customs (Plot_C1): 2 khoang + sửa/sơn/turbo
LSCustomsService.init(activeRemotes, activeHudRemote, losSantosRoot)

local STARTING_CASH = 5000

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	player:SetAttribute("Cash", STARTING_CASH)
	player:SetAttribute("Armor", 65)
	player:SetAttribute("WantedLevel", 0)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local cashStat = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cashStat.Name = "Cash"
	cashStat.Value = STARTING_CASH
	cashStat.Parent = leaderstats
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, p)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

-- Xử lý lệnh từ Menu Kiểm Thử [H]
activeHudRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cmd)
	if cmd == "spawn_car" then
		local car = VehicleManager.spawnForPlayer(player)
		if car then
			activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
				message = string.format("Legendary Motorsport: Đã giao siêu xe %s ngay trước mặt bạn!", car.Name),
				color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
			})
		end
	elseif cmd == "add_star" then
		local cur = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("WantedLevel")) or 0
		local nxt = math.min(5, cur + 1)
		player:SetAttribute("WantedLevel", nxt)
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = string.format("LSPD ALERT: Mức truy nã hiện tại là %d Sao!", nxt),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
		})
	elseif cmd == "clear_stars" then
		player:SetAttribute("WantedLevel", 0)
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = "LSPD đã ngừng truy đuổi. Bạn đã thoát truy nã!",
			color = Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86),
		})
	elseif cmd == "add_cash" then
		local nextCash = (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 0) + 500
		player:SetAttribute("Cash", nextCash)
		local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local cs = if ls then ls:FindFirstChild("Cash") else nil
		if cs and cs:IsA("IntValue") then
			cs.Value = nextCash
		end
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = "Maze Bank: Đã nhận +$500 vào tài khoản tiền mặt.",
			color = Color3.fromRGB(114, 204, 114),
		})
	elseif cmd == "add_armor" then
		local curA = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Armor")) or 0
		local nxtA = if curA >= 100 then 0 else math.min(100, curA + 50)
		player:SetAttribute("Armor", nxtA)
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = string.format("Ammu-Nation: Áo giáp chống đạn hiện tại %d%%.", nxtA),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(59, 155, 232),
		})
	elseif cmd == "test_hp" then
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if hum then
			if hum.Health <= 30 then
				hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
				activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
					message = "Los Santos Medical: Đã hồi phục 100% máu!",
					color = Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86),
				})
			else
				hum.Health = math.max(20, hum.Health - 30)
				activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
					message = "Cảnh báo sát thương! Nhấn lần nữa khi <30% để hồi đầy máu.",
					color = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
				})
			end
		end
	end
end)
