--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local WorldGrid = require(Shared:WaitForChild("WorldGrid"))

local GtaHud = {}

local RADAR_W = 258
local RADAR_H = 168
local RADAR_SCALE = 0.52 -- tỉ lệ zoom rộng chuẩn GTA V thấy rõ 4 đại lộ + bờ biển xung quanh

local function formatDollars(amount: number): string
	local negative = amount < 0
	local n = math.floor(math.abs(amount))
	local s = tostring(n)
	local formatted = s
	while true do
		local k
		formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		if k == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return (if negative then "-$" else "$") .. formatted
end

function GtaHud.mount(localPlayer: Player, hudRemote: RemoteEvent)
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	for _, oldName in ipairs({ "CityInteractiveHud", "GtaVHud" }) do
		local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild(oldName)
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "GtaVHud"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = false
	screen.Parent = playerGui

	-- ========================================================================
	-- 1. CỤM RADAR HÌNH CHỮ NHẬT + 3 THANH MÁU / GIÁP / THỂ LỰC (GÓC DƯỚI TRÁI)
	-- ========================================================================
	local radarCluster = Instance.new("Frame")
	radarCluster.Name = "RadarCluster"
	radarCluster.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	radarCluster.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, -20)
	radarCluster.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RADAR_W, RADAR_H + 14)
	radarCluster.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	radarCluster.Parent = screen

	local radarOuter = Instance.new("Frame")
	radarOuter.Name = "RadarOuter"
	radarOuter.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RADAR_W, RADAR_H)
	radarOuter.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 21, 28)
	radarOuter.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	radarOuter.BorderSizePixel = 0
	radarOuter.ClipsDescendants = true
	radarOuter.Parent = radarCluster

	local radarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	radarStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16)
	radarStroke.Thickness = 2.5
	radarStroke.Parent = radarOuter

	-- Lớp bản đồ thế giới xoay & cuộn theo tọa độ thực tế từ WorldGrid
	local mapPivot = Instance.new("Frame")
	mapPivot.Name = "MapPivot"
	mapPivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	mapPivot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.56)
	mapPivot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	mapPivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mapPivot.Parent = radarOuter

	local mapContent = Instance.new("Frame")
	mapContent.Name = "MapContent"
	mapContent.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	mapContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mapContent.Parent = mapPivot

	local function addMinimapRect(name: string, cx: number, cz: number, sx: number, sz: number, col: Color3, zIdx: number)
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.Name = name
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx * RADAR_SCALE, cz * RADAR_SCALE)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, sx * RADAR_SCALE), math.max(2, sz * RADAR_SCALE))
		f.BackgroundColor3 = col
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.ZIndex = zIdx
		f.Parent = mapContent
	end

	-- Vẽ Bờ biển Thái Bình Dương, Cát Vespucci & Đồi Vinewood lên Minimap
	addMinimapRect("Ocean", 0, 305, 720, 120, Color3.fromRGB(36, 128, 198), 2)
	addMinimapRect("BeachSand", 0, 210, 720, 72, Color3.fromRGB(214, 192, 142), 2)
	addMinimapRect("VinewoodHills", 0, -300, 720, 120, Color3.fromRGB(58, 96, 54), 2)

	-- Vẽ 6 Ô đất quy hoạch đối xứng lên Minimap
	for _, plot in ipairs(WorldGrid.PLOTS) do
		local blockCol = if plot.id == "Plot_C2"
			then Color3.fromRGB(78, 146, 84)
			else Color3.fromRGB(52, 60, 72)
		addMinimapRect(plot.id, plot.center.X, plot.center.Z, plot.size.X, plot.size.Z, blockCol, 3)
	end

	-- Vẽ toàn bộ mạng lưới 7 Đại lộ Los Santos sáng rõ chuẩn GTA V trên Minimap
	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.EW_ROADS) do
		local len = r.max - r.min
		local cx = (r.min + r.max) * 0.5
		addMinimapRect(r.id, cx, r.coord, len, r.width, Color3.fromRGB(204, 214, 226), 4)
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.NS_ROADS) do
		local len = r.max - r.min
		local cz = (r.min + r.max) * 0.5
		addMinimapRect(r.id, r.coord, cz, r.width, len, Color3.fromRGB(204, 214, 226), 4)
	end

	-- Đánh dấu Quảng Trường Trung Tâm Legion Square (lối đi chữ thập + hồ nước + Blip vàng) trên Minimap
	addMinimapRect("PlazaWalkNS_Map", 0, 57, 28, 132, Color3.fromRGB(186, 180, 168), 3)
	addMinimapRect("PlazaWalkEW_Map", 0, 57, 166, 24, Color3.fromRGB(186, 180, 168), 3)
	addMinimapRect("PlazaCourt_Map", 0, 57, 96, 86, Color3.fromRGB(196, 190, 178), 3)
	addMinimapRect("PlazaPool_Map", 0, 49, 40, 28, Color3.fromRGB(46, 168, 206), 4)
	local spawnBlip = Instance.new("Frame")
	spawnBlip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	spawnBlip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 49 * RADAR_SCALE)
	spawnBlip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9)
	spawnBlip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
	spawnBlip.ZIndex = 5
	spawnBlip.Parent = mapContent
	local sbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	sbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	sbCorner.Parent = spawnBlip
	local sbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	sbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16)
	sbStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	sbStroke.Parent = spawnBlip

	-- Lớp chớp Xanh-Đỏ cảnh sát khi có Sao Truy Nã (Wanted >= 1)
	local wantedFlash = Instance.new("Frame")
	wantedFlash.Name = "PoliceRadarFlash"
	wantedFlash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	wantedFlash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
	wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wantedFlash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	wantedFlash.ZIndex = 7
	wantedFlash.Parent = radarOuter

	-- Mũi tên vị trí người chơi ở tâm Radar
	local playerBlip = Instance.new("Frame")
	playerBlip.Name = "PlayerArrow"
	playerBlip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	playerBlip.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.56)
	playerBlip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
	playerBlip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	playerBlip.Rotation = 45
	playerBlip.ZIndex = 9
	playerBlip.Parent = radarOuter

	local pbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	pbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16)
	pbStroke.Thickness = 2
	pbStroke.Parent = playerBlip

	-- Huy hiệu chữ 'N' chỉ hướng Bắc bám viền Radar
	local northBadge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	northBadge.Name = "NorthCompass"
	northBadge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	northBadge.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 11)
	northBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
	northBadge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16)
	northBadge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	northBadge.TextSize = 11
	northBadge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
	northBadge.Text = "N"
	northBadge.ZIndex = 10
	northBadge.Parent = radarCluster
	local nbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	nbCorner.Parent = northBadge

	-- Bộ 3 Thanh Chỉ Số Sát Đáy Radar Chuẩn GTA V (Health 50% | Armor 25% | Stamina 25%)
	local barsRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	barsRow.Name = "StatusBarsRow"
	barsRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, RADAR_H + 4)
	barsRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RADAR_W, 10)
	barsRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16)
	barsRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	barsRow.Parent = radarCluster

	local function makeStatBar(name: string, xPos: number, width: number, trackCol: Color3, fillCol: Color3): Frame
		local track = Instance.new("Frame")
		track.Name = name .. "Track"
		track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(xPos + 2, 2)
		track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 6)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = trackCol
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.Parent = barsRow

		local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		fill.Name = "Fill"
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = fillCol
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.Parent = track
		return fill
	end

	-- ========================================================================
	-- 5. BẢNG MENU TEST PHONG CÁCH GTA V INTERACTION MENU (MẶC ĐỊNH ẨN — BẤM [H] ĐỂ MỞ)
	-- ========================================================================
	local openHintBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

	openHintBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 16)
	openHintBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 24)
	openHintBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16)
	openHintBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
	openHintBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	openHintBtn.TextSize = 11
	openHintBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 224, 236)
	openHintBtn.Text = "[H] Mở Menu Test"
	openHintBtn.Parent = screen
	local ohCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	ohCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	ohCorner.Parent = openHintBtn

	local testBar = Instance.new("Frame")
	testBar.Name = "DevHudTestBar"
	testBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 16)
	testBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RADAR_W, 261)
	testBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 13, 18)
	testBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	testBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	testBar.Visible = false -- Mặc định đóng để HUD sạch chuẩn GTA V, bấm [H] mới hiện!
	testBar.Parent = screen

	local tbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	tbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	tbStroke.Thickness = 2
	tbStroke.Parent = testBar

	-- Header xanh đậm đặc trưng của GTA V Interaction Menu
	local menuHeader = Instance.new("Frame")
	menuHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
	menuHeader.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 74, 148)
	menuHeader.BorderSizePixel = 0
	menuHeader.Parent = testBar

	local menuTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	menuTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 4)
	menuTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 22)
	menuTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	menuTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	menuTitle.TextSize = 15
	menuTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	menuTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	menuTitle.Text = "LOS SANTOS"
	menuTitle.Parent = menuHeader

	local menuSub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	menuSub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 23)
	menuSub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 15)
	menuSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	menuSub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	menuSub.TextSize = 10
	menuSub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	menuSub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(191, 219, 254)
	menuSub.Text = "MENU KIỂM THỬ HỆ THỐNG"
	menuSub.Parent = menuHeader

	local closeTag = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	closeTag.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
	closeTag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 22)
	closeTag.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 24, 48)
	closeTag.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	closeTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeTag.TextSize = 10
	closeTag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240)
	closeTag.Text = "[H] Đóng"
	closeTag.Parent = menuHeader
	local ctCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	ctCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	ctCorner.Parent = closeTag

	local function toggleTestMenu()
		testBar.Visible = not testBar.Visible
		openHintBtn.Visible = not testBar.Visible
	end
	openHintBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleTestMenu)
	closeTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleTestMenu)

	local testButtonsSpec = {
		{ label = "▶  Gọi Siêu Xe Trước Mặt", right = "CAR", cmd = "spawn_car", accent = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248) },
		{ label = "★  Tăng +1 Sao Truy Nã", right = "LSPD", cmd = "add_star", accent = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) },
		{ label = "☆  Xoá Toàn Bộ Truy Nã", right = "0 ★", cmd = "clear_stars", accent = Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184) },
		{ label = "$  Nhận +$500 Tiền Mặt", right = "+$500", cmd = "add_cash", accent = Color3.fromRGB(114, 204, 114) },
		{ label = "◆  Nạp / Đổi Áo Giáp", right = "ARMOR", cmd = "add_armor", accent = Color3.fromRGB(59, 155, 232) },
		{ label = "✚  Thử Sát Thương / Hồi Máu", right = "HP", cmd = "test_hp", accent = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11) },
	}
	for idx, bSpec in ipairs(testButtonsSpec) do
		local rowY = 46 + (idx - 1) * 35
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, rowY)
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 31)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 27, 36)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextSize = 12
		btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249)
		btn.Text = "   " .. bSpec.label
		btn.Parent = testBar

		local barLeft = Instance.new("Frame")
		barLeft.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0)
		barLeft.BackgroundColor3 = bSpec.accent
		barLeft.BorderSizePixel = 0
		barLeft.Parent = btn

		local rightTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		rightTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		rightTag.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
		rightTag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 18)
		rightTag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rightTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		rightTag.TextSize = 10
		rightTag.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		rightTag.TextColor3 = bSpec.accent
		rightTag.Text = bSpec.right
		rightTag.Parent = btn

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			hudRemote:FireServer(bSpec.cmd)
		end)
	end

	-- ========================================================================
	-- 6. LOGIC ĐỒNG BỘ DỮ LIỆU THỜI GIAN THỰC (SPRINT, CASH, WANTED, RADAR)
	-- ========================================================================
	local stamina = 100
	local isSprinting = false
	local lastCash = tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 5000
	local deltaToken = 0
	local lastLocationKey = ""

	cashLabel.Text = formatDollars(lastCash)

	localPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Cash"):Connect(function()
		local current = tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 0
		local diff = current - lastCash
		lastCash = current
		cashLabel.Text = formatDollars(current)

		if diff ~= 0 then
			deltaToken += 1
			local myD = deltaToken
			cashDeltaLabel.Text = (if diff > 0 then "+" else "") .. formatDollars(diff)
			cashDeltaLabel.TextColor3 = if diff > 0
				then Color3.fromRGB(240, 253, 244)
				else Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113)
			task.delay(2.4, function()
				if deltaToken == myD then
					cashDeltaLabel.Text = ""
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	local function refreshArmor()
		local armor = math.clamp(tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("Armor")) or 0, 0, 100)
		TweenService:Create(armorFill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(armor / 100, 1),
		}):Play()
	end
	localPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Armor"):Connect(refreshArmor)
	refreshArmor()

	hudRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) == "table" and type(payload.message) == "string" then
			showFeed(payload.message, payload.color)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			isSprinting = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.H then
			toggleTestMenu()
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			isSprinting = false
		end
	end)

	-- Đồng hồ tốc độ xe hơi góc dưới phải (tự hiện khi lên xe, tự ẩn khi xuống xe)
	local speedoCluster = Instance.new("Frame")
	speedoCluster.Name = "VehicleSpeedometer"
	speedoCluster.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	speedoCluster.Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, -82)
	speedoCluster.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 44)
	speedoCluster.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	speedoCluster.Visible = false
	speedoCluster.Parent = screen

	local carNameTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	carNameTag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	carNameTag.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15)
	carNameTag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	carNameTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	carNameTag.TextSize = 12
	carNameTag.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	carNameTag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	carNameTag.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	carNameTag.Text = "BANSHEE GT"
	carNameTag.Parent = speedoCluster

	local mphLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	mphLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 15)
	mphLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
	mphLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mphLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	mphLabel.TextSize = 26
	mphLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	mphLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
	mphLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 14)
	mphLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.14
	mphLabel.Text = "0 MPH"
	mphLabel.Parent = speedoCluster

	showFeed(
		"Los Santos sẵn sàng! Lại gần xe bấm [F] mở cửa lên xe • Cầm Pistol [1] / Rifle [2] bắn thử • [H] Menu Test.",
		Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86)
	)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		-- Cập nhật đồng hồ giờ game
		local ct = Lighting.ClockTime
		local hh = math.floor(ct)
		local mm = math.floor((ct - hh) * 60)
		clockChip.Text = string.format("LOS SANTOS • %02d:%02d", hh, mm)

		-- Cập nhật hiệu ứng chớp Sao Truy Nã + Chớp Xanh-Đỏ trên Radar
		local wanted = math.clamp(tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("WantedLevel")) or 0, 0, 5)
		starsRow.Visible = wanted > 0
		if wanted > 0 then
			local pulsePhase = math.floor(os.clock() * 4.2) % 2 == 0
			wantedFlash.BackgroundColor3 = if pulsePhase
				then Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
				else Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246)
			wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84

			for i = 1, 5 do
				local st = starLabels[i]
				if i <= wanted then
					st.TextTransparency = 0
					st.TextColor3 = if pulsePhase
						then Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						else Color3.fromRGB(191, 219, 254)
				else
					st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 36, 46)
					st.TextTransparency = 0.42
				end
			end
		else
			wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end

		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") or not hum then
			return
		end

		-- Máu (Health)
		local hpRatio = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(1, hum.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
		healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hpRatio, 1)
		healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = if hpRatio < 0.3
			then Color3.fromRGB(220, 56, 56)
			else Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86)

		-- Thể lực chạy nhanh (Stamina)
		local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		if isSprinting and moving and stamina > 1 then
			stamina = math.max(0, stamina - 22 * dt)
			hum.WalkSpeed = 24
		else
			stamina = math.min(100, stamina + 16 * dt)
			hum.WalkSpeed = 16
		end
		staminaFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(stamina / 100, 1)

		-- Cuộn & xoay Minimap theo Camera và vị trí người chơi
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camLook = if cam then cam.CFrame.LookVector else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local camHeadingRad = math.atan2(camLook.X, -camLook.Z)
		local mapRotDeg = -math.deg(camHeadingRad)

		local pos = hrp.Position
		mapPivot.Rotation = mapRotDeg
		mapContent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-pos.X * RADAR_SCALE, -pos.Z * RADAR_SCALE)

		-- Xoay mũi tên người chơi tương đối so với góc xoay Camera
		local charLook = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		local charHeadingRad = math.atan2(charLook.X, -charLook.Z)
		playerBlip.Rotation = math.deg(charHeadingRad - camHeadingRad) + 45

		-- Đưa chữ 'N' (Hướng Bắc = -Z) chạy dọc mép khung chữ nhật Radar
		local northAngle = -camHeadingRad - math.pi / 2
		local nx = math.clamp(0.5 + math.cos(northAngle) * 0.46, 0.06, 0.94)
		local ny = math.clamp(0.5 + math.sin(northAngle) * 0.46, 0.07, 0.93)
		northBadge.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, 0, ny * RADAR_H)

		-- Cập nhật đồng hồ tốc độ MPH khi ngồi trên xe GTA V
		local seatPart = hum.SeatPart
		local activeCar = if seatPart then seatPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") else nil
		if activeCar and activeCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
			local mph = tonumber(activeCar:GetAttribute("CurrentMPH")) or 0
			local cname = tostring(activeCar:GetAttribute("VehicleDisplayName") or activeCar.Name)
			carNameTag.Text = string.upper(cname)
			mphLabel.Text = string.format("%d MPH", mph)
			speedoCluster.Visible = true
		else
			speedoCluster.Visible = false
		end

		-- Cập nhật chữ Khu Vực & Tên Đường góc dưới phải
		local distName, stName = WorldGrid.getLocationInfo(pos)
		local locKey = distName .. "|" .. stName
		if locKey ~= lastLocationKey then
			lastLocationKey = locKey
			districtLabel.Text = distName
			streetLabel.Text = stName
		end
	end)

	return screen
end

return GtaHud

--!strict
--[[
	LSCustomsUI.luau
	================================================================================
	GIAO DIỆN ĐỘ XE LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS (chuẩn GTA V — gọn, không che màn hình)
	================================================================================
	• Chip "[E] ĐỘ XE" nhỏ nằm sát đáy màn hình chỉ hiện khi xe đang nằm trong khoang.
	• Bấm [E] (hoặc chạm chip) mở bảng độ xe: SỬA CHỮA / SƠN LẠI / TURBO kèm giá tiền,
	  phím tắt [1] [2] [3], đóng bằng [ESC] hoặc nút X.
	• Mọi thao tác đều do server xác thực (tiền, khoang trống, cấp Turbo) rồi trả kết quả về.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function formatDollars(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local out = s
	while true do
		local formatted, k = string.gsub(out, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		out = formatted
		if k == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return "$" .. out
end

function LSCustomsUI.mount(localPlayer: Player)

	-- ===========================================================

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")

	local panelPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	panelPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
	panelPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
	panelPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14)
	panelPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14)
	panelPad.Parent = panel

	local header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	header.TextSize = 16
	header.TextColor3 = ACCENT
	header.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	header.Text = "LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS"
	header.Parent = panel

	local subHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	subHeader.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
	subHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 16)
	subHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subHeader.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	subHeader.TextSize = 12
	subHeader.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 178, 192)
	subHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	subHeader.Text = "Đang chờ xe trong khoang..."
	subHeader.Parent = panel

	local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = ROW_BG
	closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeButton.Text = "X"
	closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeButton.TextSize = 12
	closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240)
	closeButton.Parent = panel

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeButton

	local list = Instance.new("Frame")
	list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 152)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.Parent = panel

	local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
	listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	listLayout.Parent = list

	local footer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	footer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	footer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
	footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	footer.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	footer.TextSize = 11
	footer.TextWrapped = true
	footer.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	footer.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
	footer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175)
	footer.Text = "[1] [2] [3] chọn dịch vụ   •   [ESC] đóng bảng"
	footer.Parent = panel

	type Row = {
		button: TextButton,
		title: TextLabel,
		price: TextLabel,
		action: string,
	}

	local rows: { Row } = {}

	local specs = {
		{ action = "repair", index = "1", title = "SỬA CHỮA TOÀN XE", hint = "Hồi 100% máu ẩn mọi chi tiết" },
		{ action = "paint", index = "2", title = "SƠN LẠI VỎ XE", hint = "Đổi màu sơn theo bảng màu GTA V" },
		{ action = "turbo", index = "3", title = "NÂNG CẤP TURBO", hint = "Tăng tốc độ tối đa (tối đa 3 cấp)" },
	}

	for i, spec in ipairs(specs) do
		local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
		row.Name = "Row_" .. spec.action
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = ROW_BG
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
		row.BorderSizePixel = 0
		row.AutoButtonColor = true
		row.Text = ""
		row.LayoutOrder = i
		row.Parent = list

		local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
		rowCorner.Parent = row

		local rowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		rowStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 66, 82)
		rowStroke.Transparency = 0.35
		rowStroke.Thickness = 1
		rowStroke.Parent = row

		local keyTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		keyTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		keyTag.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
		keyTag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
		keyTag.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 48, 62)
		keyTag.BorderSizePixel = 0
		keyTag.Text = spec.index
		keyTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		keyTag.TextSize = 12
		keyTag.TextColor3 = ACCENT
		keyTag.Parent = row

		local keyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		keyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		keyCorner.Parent = keyTag

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 6)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 16)
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 242, 250)
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.Text = spec.title
		title.Parent = row

		local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 22)
		hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14)
		hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hint.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		hint.TextSize = 10
		hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(142, 152, 168)
		hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		hint.Text = spec.hint
		hint.Parent = row

		local price = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		price.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		price.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
		price.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 18)
		price.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		price.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		price.TextSize = 13
		price.TextColor3 = ACCENT
		price.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		price.Text = "--"
		price.Parent = row

		table.insert(rows, { button = row, title = title, price = price, action = spec.action })
	end

	-- ===========================================================
	-- 3. TRẠNG THÁI + ĐIỀU KHIỂN
	-- ===========================================================
	local promptVisible = false
	local currentBay = 0
	local menuOpen = false

	local function setPanelOpen(open: boolean)
		menuOpen = open
		panel.Visible = open
		if open then
			panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(356, 268)
			TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(372, 268),
			}):Play()
		end
	end

	local function refreshPrices(car: any)
		if type(car) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local prices = car.prices
		local turboLevel = tonumber(car.turbo) or 0
		subHeader.Text = string.format("%s   •   Hư hỏng %d%%   •   Turbo cấp %d", tostring(car.name), tonumber(car.damagePct) or 0, turboLevel)
		for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
			local price = if type(prices) == "table" then tonumber(prices[row.action]) else nil
			if price then
				row.price.Text = formatDollars(price)
				row.price.TextColor3 = ACCENT
			end
			if row.action == "turbo" then
				row.title.Text = if turboLevel >= 3 then "NÂNG CẤP TURBO (TỐI ĐA)" else "NÂNG CẤP TURBO"
				row.title.TextColor3 = if turboLevel >= 3 then Color3.fromRGB(140, 150, 165) else Color3.fromRGB(236, 242, 250)
			end
		end
	end

	chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if promptVisible then
			remote:FireServer({ action = "open", bay = currentBay })
		end
	end)

	closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		setPanelOpen(false)
		remote:FireServer({ action = "close", bay = currentBay })
	end)

	local function fireRow(action: string)
		if not menuOpen then
			return
		end
		remote:FireServer({ action = action, bay = currentBay })
	end

	for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
		row.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			fireRow(row.action)
		end)
	end

	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local kind = payload.kind
		if kind == "prompt" then
			promptVisible = payload.visible == true
			currentBay = tonumber(payload.bay) or 0
			chip.Visible = promptVisible and not menuOpen
			if promptVisible then
				local vehicle = tostring(payload.vehicle or "")
				chipLabel.Text = if vehicle ~= "" then string.format("ĐỘ XE — %s", string.upper(vehicle)) else "ĐỘ XE — LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS"
			end
			if not promptVisible then
				setPanelOpen(false)
			end
		elseif kind == "menu" then
			currentBay = tonumber(payload.bay) or currentBay
			refreshPrices(payload.car)
			footer.Text = "[1] [2] [3] chọn dịch vụ   •   [ESC] đóng bảng"
			footer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175)
			setPanelOpen(true)
			chip.Visible = false
		elseif kind == "closed" then
			setPanelOpen(false)
			chip.Visible = promptVisible
		elseif kind == "result" then
			local ok = payload.ok == true
			footer.Text = tostring(payload.message or "")
			footer.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(86, 226, 140) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 118, 108)
			if payload.car then
				refreshPrices(payload.car)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end
		if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
			if promptVisible and not menuOpen then
				remote:FireServer({ action = "open", bay = currentBay })
			end
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			if menuOpen then
				setPanelOpen(false)
				remote:FireServer({ action = "close", bay = currentBay })
			end
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then
			fireRow("repair")
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Two then
			fireRow("paint")
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Three then
			fireRow("turbo")
		end
	end)

	local function hideOnSeatChange()
		if menuOpen then
			setPanelOpen(false)
		end
	end
	localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		chip.Visible = false
		setPanelOpen(false)
		hideOnSeatChange()
	end)
end

return LSCustomsUI

VehiclePromptUI.source:
--!strict
--[[
	VehiclePromptUI.luau
	Giao diện nút [F] lên xe thiết kế lại chuẩn GTA V (nhỏ gọn, tinh tế, KHÔNG BAO GIỜ chắn giữa màn hình):
	- Thay thế hoàn toàn bảng ProximityPrompt xám khổng lồ mặc định của Roblox (vì prompt.Style = Custom).
	- TỰ ĐỘNG ẨN 100% ngay lập tức khi nhân vật đã ngồi trên bất kỳ ghế nào (SeatPart ~= nil) -> không bao giờ
	  hiện nhầm nút "Vào ghế phụ" chắn ngang người khi đang ngồi lái!
	- Khi đi bộ lại gần tay nắm cửa xe:
	  1. Chấm ghim phím [F] siêu nhỏ (22x22 px) gắn gọn ngay trên tay nắm cửa 3D để biết đang đứng gần cửa nào.
	  2. Thanh chip mỏng 228x30 px nằm sát mép đáy màn hình (giữa Minimap & Tên Đường), bấm chuột/chạm tay cũng vào xe được!
]]

local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local VehiclePromptUI = {}

function VehiclePromptUI.mount(localPlayer: Player)
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

	local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GtaVehiclePromptGui")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "GtaVehiclePromptGui"
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.DisplayOrder = 18
	screen.Parent = playerGui

	-- 1. Thanh Chip Gọn Nhẹ Sát Mép Đáy Màn Hình (Không bao giờ che nhân vật hay thân xe!)
	local bottomChip = Instance.new("TextButton")
	bottomChip.Name = "BottomActionChip"
	bottomChip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	bottomChip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18)
	bottomChip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(234, 30)
	bottomChip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 13, 18)
	bottomChip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.14
	bottomChip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bottomChip.AutoButtonColor = true
	bottomChip.Text = ""
	bottomChip.Visible = false
	bottomChip.Parent = screen

	local chipCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	chipCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	chipCorner.Parent = bottomChip

	local chipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	chipStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	chipStroke.Transparency = 0.35
	chipStroke.Thickness = 1.2
	chipStroke.Parent = bottomChip

	local keyBadge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	keyBadge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	keyBadge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0)
	keyBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	keyBadge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249)
	keyBadge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	keyBadge.TextSize = 12
	keyBadge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24)
	keyBadge.Text = "F"
	keyBadge.Parent = bottomChip

	local kbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	kbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	kbCorner.Parent = keyBadge

	local actionLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	actionLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	actionLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0.5, 0)
	actionLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 1, 0)
	actionLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	actionLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	actionLabel.TextSize = 12
	actionLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	actionLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249)
	actionLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	actionLabel.Text = "Vào ghế lái • Banshee GT"
	actionLabel.Parent = bottomChip

	-- 2. Chấm Ghim Nhỏ Gọn (22x22 px) Gắn Đúng Tay Nắm Cửa 3D (nhỏ gấp 15 lần bảng mặc định của Roblox!)
	local handlePin = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	handlePin.Name = "DoorHandleMiniPin"
	handlePin.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
	handlePin.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)
	handlePin.AlwaysOnTop = true
	handlePin.Enabled = false
	handlePin.Parent = screen

	local pinBox = Instance.new("Frame")
	pinBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	pinBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24)
	pinBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	pinBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	pinBox.Parent = handlePin

	local pinCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	pinCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	pinCorner.Parent = pinBox

	local pinStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	pinStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	pinStroke.Thickness = 1.4
	pinStroke.Parent = pinBox

	local pinTxt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	pinTxt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	pinTxt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pinTxt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	pinTxt.TextSize = 11
	pinTxt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
	pinTxt.Text = "F"
	pinTxt.Parent = pinBox

	local currentPrompt: ProximityPrompt? = nil

	local function isPlayerSeated(): boolean
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		return hum ~= nil and hum.SeatPart ~= nil
	end

	local function refreshVisibility()
		local pr = currentPrompt
		if not pr or not pr.Parent or not pr.Enabled or isPlayerSeated() then
			bottomChip.Visible = false
			handlePin.Enabled = false
			handlePin.Adornee = nil
			return
		end

		local keyName = pr.KeyboardKeyCode.Name
		if keyName == "" or keyName == "Unknown" then
			keyName = "F"
		end
		keyBadge.Text = keyName
		pinTxt.Text = keyName

		local obj = pr.ObjectText
		local act = pr.ActionText
		actionLabel.Text = if obj ~= "" then (act .. " • " .. obj) else act

		local adornee = pr.Parent
		if adornee and adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
			handlePin.Adornee = adornee
			handlePin.Enabled = true
		else
			handlePin.Adornee = nil
			handlePin.Enabled = false
		end
		bottomChip.Visible = true
	end

	-- Cho phép bấm trực tiếp vào thanh Chip đáy màn hình (hỗ trợ cả Mobile / Chuột!)
	bottomChip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local pr = currentPrompt
		if pr and pr.Parent and pr.Enabled and not isPlayerSeated() then
			pr:InputHoldBegin()
			pr:InputHoldEnd()
		end
	end)

	ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
		if prompt.Style ~= Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom then
			return
		end
		currentPrompt = prompt
		refreshVisibility()
	end)

	ProximityPromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(function(prompt)
		if currentPrompt == prompt then
			currentPrompt = nil
			refreshVisibility()
		end
	end)

	-- Kiểm tra liên tục mỗi frame: vừa đặt mông lên ghế lái là ẩn sạch nút [F] trong 0.00s!
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if currentPrompt ~= nil then
			refreshVisibility()
		elseif bottomChip.Visible or handlePin.Enabled then
			bottomChip.Visible = false
			handlePin.Enabled = false
		end
	end)
end

return VehiclePromptUI

--[[
	WeaponClient.luau
	Tâm ngắm chấm trắng chuẩn GTA V + Bắn tia đạn Tracer + Hiệu ứng nháy tâm khi bắn trúng / bắn vỡ khối!
	(Giữ nguyên quy tắc MÁU ẨN: tuyệt đối không hiện thanh máu thô trên gạch đá/xe).
]]

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local WeaponClient = {}

local function drawLocalTracer(startPos: Vector3, endPos: Vector3)
	local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
	if dist < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local beam = Instance.new("Part")
	beam.Name = "BulletTracer"
	beam.Anchored = true
	beam.CanCollide = false
	beam.CanQuery = false
	beam.CastShadow = false
	beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 102)
	beam.Transparency = 0.25
	beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.09, 0.09, dist)
	beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((startPos + endPos) * 0.5, endPos)
	beam.Parent = Workspace
	Debris:AddItem(beam, 0.055)
end

function WeaponClient.mount(localPlayer: Player, fireRemote: RemoteEvent)
	local mouse = localPlayer:GetMouse()
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local reticleGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	reticleGui.Name = "GtaWeaponReticle"
	reticleGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	reticleGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	reticleGui.Parent = playerGui

	-- Tâm ngắm chấm trắng nhỏ gọn chuẩn GTA V (bám theo vị trí trỏ chuột khi cầm súng)
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Name = "AimDot"
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	dot.Visible = false
	dot.Parent = reticleGui
	local dCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	dCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	dCorner.Parent = dot
	local dStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	dStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	dStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	dStroke.Parent = dot

	-- Nháy dấu '×' mảnh khi đạn trúng Part có máu ẩn (Đỏ rực khi viên đạn đó làm VỠ TUNG khối!)
	local hitTick = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hitTick.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	hitTick.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	hitTick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
	hitTick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hitTick.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	hitTick.TextSize = 16
	hitTick.Text = "×"
	hitTick.TextTransparency = 1
	hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	hitTick.Parent = dot

	local tickToken = 0
	fireRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(evt, shattered)
		if evt == "hit" then
			tickToken += 1
			local myT = tickToken
			hitTick.TextColor3 = if shattered
				then Color3.fromRGB(248, 62, 62)
				else Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
			hitTick.TextSize = if shattered then 21 else 15
			hitTick.TextTransparency = 0
			hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
			task.delay(0.14, function()
				if tickToken == myT then
					hitTick.TextTransparency = 1
					hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	local holdingTrigger = false
	local lastLocalShot = 0

	local function getEquippedGtaWeapon(): Tool?
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		if not char then
			return nil
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if tool and tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") == true then
			return tool
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function tryFireOnce(tool: Tool)
		local cd = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("FireCooldown")) or 0.16
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastLocalShot < cd then
			return
		end
		lastLocalShot = now

		local muzzle = tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle") :: BasePart?
		local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart?
		local origin = if muzzle then muzzle.Position elseif handle then handle.Position else nil
		if not origin then
			return
		end

		local targetPos = mouse.Hit.Position
		local dir = targetPos - origin
		if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			return
		end

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if char then { char } else {}
		local res = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir.Unit * 350, params)
		local endPt = if res then res.Position else (origin + dir.Unit * 180)

		drawLocalTracer(origin, endPt)
		fireRemote:FireServer(origin, targetPos)
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			local tool = getEquippedGtaWeapon()
			if tool then
				holdingTrigger = true
				tryFireOnce(tool)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			holdingTrigger = false
		end
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local tool = getEquippedGtaWeapon()
		if tool then
			local loc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(loc.X, loc.Y)
			dot.Visible = true
			if holdingTrigger and tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire") == true then
				tryFireOnce(tool)
			end
		else
			dot.Visible = false
			holdingTrigger = false
		end
	end)
end

return WeaponClient

Client.source:
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GtaRemotes")
local hudRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("HudAction") :: RemoteEvent
local weaponRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("WeaponFire") :: RemoteEvent

local GtaHud = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("GtaHud"))
local VehiclePromptUI = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("VehiclePromptUI"))
local LSCustomsUI = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("LSCustomsUI"))
local WeaponClient = require(script:WaitForChild("WeaponClient"))

GtaHud.mount(localPlayer, hudRemote)
VehiclePromptUI.mount(localPlayer)
LSCustomsUI.mount(localPlayer)
WeaponClient.mount(localPlayer, weaponRemote)
